articleTitle: Principal Component Analysis of Key Gases in Transformer Oil using DGA Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Using principal component analysis, this investigation examines the Key Gases (KG) H<inf>2</inf>, CH<inf>4</inf>, C<inf>2</inf>H<inf>6</inf>, C<inf>2</inf>H<inf>4</inf>, and C<inf>2</inf>H<inf>4</inf> (PCA). To ascertain the contribution of each KG towards the nascent faults in PT, the varied composition of KG in Power Transformer (PT) is employed as input data. The 3D components plot utilized in the analysis’s KG compositions shows how each KG, regardless of compositional differences, might raise the temperature of oil in PT. According to the connection between the PCA components, component 1 and component 2 wiggle all the KG in a positive direction, while component 2 and component 3 show that H<inf>2</inf> and C<inf>2</inf>H<inf>2</inf> are viable in a positive direction and that CH<inf>4</inf>, C<inf>2</inf>H<inf>6</inf>, and C<inf>2</inf>H<inf>4</inf> are impacted in a negative direction. Each component’s score and coefficients, numbered 1 through 5, are comparable to major components. As a result, the proposed study offers details on each KG along with their key contributing factors. This study shows that data may be well interpreted while maintaining the greatest amount of information, and it reduces the complexity of highly dimensional data while preserving trends and patterns.

articleTitle: Development of IoT Enabled Framework for LPG Gas Leakage Detection and Weight Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Within any country, the safety of the citizens is a major concern. Since LPG is highly flammable and can create dangerous situations in life. To avoid such situations, this system modifies the existing safety system of LPG leakage detection. The primary aim of the research is to minimize the casualties caused by the leakage of Gas in indoor as well as outdoor environments by early detection of it and simultaneously monitoring the weight of the domestic gas cylinder as well as commercial cylinders. This system is IoT enabled which can sense leakage in the early phase and through weight monitoring system at the same time transmit data to remote location using SMS to the owner and near the authorized gas agency. IoT is basically a system of interconnected devices that can communicate and share real- time information from sensor to remote locations via internet. With the help of this technology, various devices can be controlled and can communicate with one another. In our system, gas leakage detects through gas sensor and also book a new gas cylinder from gas agency whenever the amount of gas is less than the threshold amount. Also, the data will be automatically updated on the server and can be accessed by the authorized person present in any part of the world. It provides real-time information for quick detection and offers a high level of accuracy in the detection of LPG gas. In the last part of the paper, security concern related to IoT technology has been discussed. The future gradation or scope of our system is mentioned at the end of this paper.

articleTitle: Federated learning: Applications, Security hazards and Defense measures
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Federated learning(FL), a cutting-edge method of distributed learning, enables multiple users to share training results while maintaining the privacy of their personal data. Collecting data from different data owners for making machine learning predictions becomes increasingly challenging as data security becomes more of a priority. Federated learning protects user’s privacy in addition to increase the training data while overcoming the challenges faced by machine learning and deep learning models. Since the data privacy and security is a world-wide concern, the concept of federated learning is increasing day by day from theoretical to practical level. This review paper involves the overview of the federated learning framework, its types, different applications, several types of attacks and defense mechanism.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Approach for Detection of Diabetic Retinopathy
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Early Detection of Diabetic Retinopathy is paramount in prevention of vision loss. This study proposes a novel approach to the automatic detection of diabetic retinopathy (DR) using fundus images. This paper compares other techniques and does comparative study of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and the ResNet architecture to analyze fundus images and classify them based on the severity of DR. The study uses the APTOS 2019 Blindness Detection dataset, a publicly available dataset of over 5,000 high-resolution retinal images collected from patients with varying degrees of DR. The study concludes that the proposed approach provides a promising solution for the automatic detection and classification of DR.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study on the Effectiveness of Various Machine Learning Paradigms in Image Recognition and Predictive Modelling
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: The efficiency of several machine learning algorithms in picture identification and predictive modelling is thoroughly compared in this research article. The necessity to find the best algorithms for certain use cases and the rising need for reliable and effective image recognition systems across a variety of areas are the driving forces behind the study. In order to assess how well these algorithms, perform in terms of accuracy, precision, and recall, the study uses a wide range of machine learning techniques, including classical and deep learning approaches. The study's findings show that convolutional neural networks, in particular, outperform conventional algorithms in image identification tests while standard and deep learning techniques perform similarly in tasks requiring predictive modelling. The study also emphasises the value of transfer learning and fine-tuning strategies in obtaining cutting-edge performance on picture datasets, and finally we will see results at the end.

articleTitle: Python And Opencv For Sign Language Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Hearing-impaired people cannot communicate with normal people easily. Most people are not aware of sign language recognition. To support this, machine learning and CV can be used to create an impact on the impaired. This can be improved into automatic editors, in which the person can easily understand the sign language of the impaired people by just using hand sign recognition. In non-verbal communication, hand gesture always being an important mode of communication and it plays a vital role to bridge gap between deaf and dumb people. Several sign language recognition systems have been developed but the systems are not flexible and cost-effective. Physically challenged people can express their emotions and feelings through sign language. In this paper, we develop a sign detector that can detect signs and numbers and also other signs that are used in sign language with the help of OpenCV and Keras modules in python. By using this technology, we can understand what they want to convey through sign language which is not a common language to communicate with people. OpenCV and Keras of python are the modules used to achieve our work and the proposed work proved to be a user-friendly approach to communication by using Python language to recognize sign languages for hearing-impaired persons.

articleTitle: Community Detection in Networks: A Comparative study
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: In this paper, various approaches for community detection in complex networks are studied. The existence of community structure is most important features for community detection algorithms in a complex network. These algorithms are based on order to unmask the structural properties of the network and dynamic behaviors with the maximization of modularity. As a result, one of the most challenging problems in network is community detection i.e. NP-hard in modern network science. In this paper an improved Louvain Algorithm has been embodied that reduces the computational time and also maximize the modularity due to resolution limit.

articleTitle: Extreme Gradient Boost Classifier based Credit Card Fraud Detection Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Financial fraud has evolved into an extremely serious problem in the business world. The effects of financial fraud on businesses, the economy, and people’s standard of living are widespread. Credit card fraud describes the shady practice of using personal information for online purchases. As the use of credit cards grows, so does the prevalence of fraud involving these payments. These days, credit card transactions are commonplace not only for online but also for in-store purchases. However, it has also made it easier for scammers to take advantage of this great opportunity. We can identify fraudulent transactions using Credit Card Fraud Detection. To handle imbalanced data, the proposed model in this work employs the XGBoost classifier to detect fraud transactions. The typical technique pre-determines the threshold value, resulting in inefficiency. Thus, in our proposed approach, several threshold values are computed and compared to identify the ideal value that provides an optimal outcome and high efficiency.

articleTitle: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs): Evaluation of OLSR, DSDV, AODV, and DSR Dynamic Routing Protocols
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Flying Ad hoc Networks (Flying ad hoc networks) made up of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are now widely used in civilian and non-civilian applications. In FANET, communication among UAVs needs to be properly coordinated through the exchange of messages among them. This leads to the requirement of a proper routing protocol for such UAV Networks or FANET. Because of the high mobility of such networks developing suitable routing protocols is very challenging. In this manuscript, the existing routing protocols are examined through extensive simulation for their suitability for usage in such a complex environment. The Packet receiving rate of different routing protocols such as Ad-Hoc on-demand distance vector (AODV), Destination Sequenced distance vector (DSDV), Optimized link state routing (OLSR), and dynamic source routing (DSR) is recorded by varying node density and speed of nodes. Simulation is done by using Network Simulator3 simulations. It was found that among these protocols AODV is outperforming all other protocols for such scenarios.

articleTitle: A Paradigm Shift towards Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: In today’s world, machine learning, artificial intelligence, IoT, deep learning and several other techniques have become the need of the moment. One such division of artificial intelligence is computer vision. The main goal of computer vision development is to create paradigms for extracting data and information from images. It has various applications in the fields of industry, agriculture, automations, healthcare, e-commerce and much more. The study examines the most recent events and conceptual frameworks governing the progress of computer vision, with a focus on pattern recognition and image processing, using a variety of applications from the t field. This article attempts to discuss the most current results and applications in computer vision.

articleTitle: Prediction and detection of nutrition deficiency using machine learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: The plant producers have a hard time identifying nutritional inadequacies in their crops. The capacity to recognize these comprehensive nutritional deficiencies could help regulate crops properly. Using image processing, Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), the researchers were able to categorize and identify complete nutritional deficiencies in various cultivars. The prototypes would provide prescribed plant fertilizers once nutrient insufficiency was recognized. Iron (Fe), magnesium (Mg), potassium (K), nitrogen (N), calcium (Ca) and complete nutrition were examined. For classifying the image processing techniques were used to turn the images into grayscale & binary data. Using identification and prediction, CNN predicts complete nutritional deficiencies in the plant. CNN high accuracy of detection and diagnosis of nutrient deficits in different cultivars, according to the results compared with Artificial Neural Network (ANN) and DenseNet-121. The design has been tested and the results demonstrate a better way to classify and diagnose complete nutritional deficits in different cultivars.

articleTitle: Analysis of Heart Disease Prediction using Various Machine Learning Techniques: A Review Study
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Heart-related illnesses, often known as Cardiovascular diseases (CVDs) have over the past few decades become the major cause of death worldwide and the most dangerous ailment in both India and the rest of the world. The medicinal services industry contains large a measure of knowledge. This large measure of information, the infection is frequently anticipated, distinguished, or might be relieved. A serious risk to humanity is caused by infections such as cardiovascular disease, cancerous development, tumour, and so forth. Within this article, We attempt to focus on coronary illness forecast, utilizing AI methods, coronary illness is regularly anticipated. The knowledge likes pulse, hypertension, diabetes, cigarette smoking is used as information, and these highlights are then shown as a forecast. The calculations like Random Forest, KNN, and choice tree are use. In this paper, we predict the complete analysis of heart disease. The precision of the prototype is to investigate using each computation. Because of the model for predicting the infection of daringness, action is conducted at that point with greater precision. The use of machine learning algorithms by researchers is speeding up the creation of software that can help physicians with the diagnosis and prognosis of heart ailment. The main objective of this work is to forecast a patient's heart state using machine learning techniques.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Based Handwriting Digit Recognition (HDR) - A Technical Review
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: The ability of a computer to recognise and interpret handwritten input is referred to as "handwritten text recognition," proving an intangible ability for artificial intelligence (AI). The documents could be in the form of a scanned handwritten text or a photograph of a handwritten note that has accuracy issues from the start of the handwriting recognition process. The major problem is the availability of a wide range of handwriting that may be good or bad. The computer needs to be trained with enough examples, but when it comes to accuracy, it becomes challenging due to characters with similar looks. Further, if the letters are all connected, it also makes it hard for a computer to recognise accurately. In the case of a photograph of handwriting, if the angle is changed, it would result in obscure characters that would be harder for a computer to recognise. There is a lot to learn for a computer, so artificial intelligence comes into play, which allows the computer to learn over time and adapt its output. The computer can recognise hastily scribbled text and normal handwritten letters, which greatly improves the accuracy and ability of the system.

articleTitle: RGB-D Dataset: The Impact of Yoga and Gym Exercise for Human Activity Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Gesture technology is the future technology because it is widely used in different fields like computer game and sports, e-commerce, assistant system and Human robot interaction. Body gesture one of the most important recognition gesture for navigation automation cars, surveillance, 3D-animations, health sector and so many. Therefore, in this paper two types of datasets Gym dataset and yoga dataset are created for body gesture recognition. Gym dataset contains total body exercises RGB images 1992 of 1080 x 608 pixels with two subjects and two classes and same in yoga dataset total RGB images are 3012 of 2336 x 1080 pixels with one subject and four classes. All datasets are captured by camera at different views which has special configuration. This dataset is free to use for only experiment purpose.

articleTitle: Effect of Wfin, Hfin and Lg on the performance of 14-nm FinFET for analog and RF applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: FinFET devices have been popular for decades since their development due to their excellent gate-to-channel control, resulting in excellent immunity to short-channel effects (SCE). The 14nm silicon-on-insulator n-FinFET was designed and tested to accelerate the development of this rapidly evolving technology by evaluating the effect of different fin widths, fin heights and gate lengths on RF performance. The reported results allow for greater knowledge and deeper analysis into the consequences of modifying the parameters on device performance, thus allowing the manufacturing of the device to be customized as per the given requirements and demands. After analysis of the optimal results from various adjustments, we can have a significant increase in electrical properties from this novel device. This 14- nm Silicon-on-insulator (SOI) FinFET is designed and calibrated using Silvaco TCAD tools.

articleTitle: Interpolative AMBTC based Reversible Data Hiding In Encrypted Images using Rhombus Mean
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: This paper proposes an interpolative absolute moment block truncation coding (IAMBTC) based reversible data hiding method in encrypted images (RDHEI) using rhombus mean. The proposed method aims to increase the embedding efficacy by reserving more room before encryption, for embedding the confidential data. For this, the cover image is divided into a checkerboard pattern - grey cells and white cells. Grey cells are calculated using rhombus mean to group the same intensity pixels. Next, the IAMBTC is employed first on the grey cells and difference errors are stored. Afterward, the white cells are compressed using I<inf>AMBTC</inf> and their difference is also stored. The complete difference information is then compressed using Huffman coding to condense its size and make bigger rooms for embedding. Experimental results demonstrate that the suggested method outperforms existing related methods in terms of hiding efficiency.

articleTitle: Computerized Face Mask Detection System Using Deep CNN and Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Since the COVID-19 pandemic is on the rise again with hazardous effects in China, it has become very crucial for global individuals and the authorities to avoid spreading of the virus. This research aims to identify algorithms with high accuracy and moderate computing complexity at the same time (although conventional machine learning works on low computation power, we have rather used CNN for our research work as the accuracy of CNN is drastically greater than the former), to identify the proper enforcement of face masks. In order to find the best Neural Network architecture we used many deep CNN Methodologies to solve classification problem in regards of masked and non masked image dataset. In this approach we applied different model architectures, like VGG16, Resnet50, Resnet101 and VGG19, on a large dataset to train on and compared the model on the basis of accuracy in which VGG16 came out to be the best. VGG16 was further tuned with different optimizers to determine the one best fit of the model. VGG16 gave an ideal accuracy of 99.37% with the best fit optimizer over a real life data set.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Static and Mobile Anchors in Sensor Localization
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: The sensor nodes in wireless sensor networks (WSNs) are deployed randomly in structured, unstructured, or harsh environments. The measured or sensed data by sensors is meaningful only if its location is known. The process of creating location awareness in all deployed sensor nodes is known as localization. Only a few sensors known as anchors are placed at predetermined locations manually or equipped with a global positioning system. Anchor locations are used by remaining unknown nodes to estimate the location. Minimizing the number of anchors is an important challenge in WSN. This issue is addressed using a single mobile anchor in this paper. Simulation results show that multiple anchors can be replaced by a single mobile anchor. This is a cost and energy-effective solution with a trade-off in the accuracy and localization coverage.

articleTitle: Analysis of Attack Patterns and Cyber Threats in Healthcare Sector
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Information Technology (IT) has become the integral part of majority of businesses. Healthcare sector is also one such sector where IT adoption is increased in recent times. This adoption of IT has increased the internet exposure and hence increased the attack surface of the organisations working in healthcare sector. During covid outbreak, we have observed various cyber-attack and threats on organisations operating in healthcare sector. This paper focuses on cyber threat pattern in healthcare sector during covid-19 outbreak and post-covid-19 period. This research paper also aims to generate basic cyber awareness through generic cyber sanity checks to secure healthcare sector from malicious threat actors. The adaptation of proactive measures required to enhance the cyber hygiene of organisations becomes very essential in this sector.

articleTitle: Ev-MDP : A Novel Metaheuristic Technique for Heart Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Heart Disease (HD) refers to a wide range of Cardio Vascular Diseases (CVD) that may be plaque deposits in the arteries or any other abnormality in the heart or blood vessels. Such abnormalities are very small but hard to detect. Sudden closure of one of the arteries in the heart or abrupt rupture of an artery can lead to a Heart Attack which may fall to premature death. Nowadays, an unhealthy, and stressful lifestyle has become vogue. It causes cardiovascular abnormalities. Early detection of such abnormalities allows alerting the person in advance and facilitates taking precautions. Meta-heuristic techniques are prominently being used for diagnosing heart disease by analyzing the healthcare dataset. A novel technique namely Evolution with Mathematical Diversification of Population (i.e., Ev-MDP) is proposed for early Heart Disease Detection. The datasets used are Statlog Heart Dataset from the UCI repository. The suggested technique is statistically compared with the state-of- the-art metaheuristic techniques. It is concluded that the Ev-MDP has a promising performance with values of 98.8%, 99.39%, 98.99%, 98.6%, and 98.8% for the Accuracy measure, AUC score, Precision, Recall, and F-measure respectively after conducting an empirical comparison with the state-of-art models.

articleTitle: A Low Power Feedback Cutting 8T SRAM Cell for Improved Stability
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: This paper presents a feed-back cutting 8T (FC8T) SRAM for stability enhancement and to mitigate the power consumption. The design specifications such as noise margin, power, and delay are considered for comparison. For the performance evaluation of the proposed FC8T SRAM (PFC8T), it is compared with conventional6T, conventional8T, MG8T, and Kushwa8T SRAM. The results clearly states that the PFC8T SRAM achieves low power utilization during read, write and hold operations compared to existing cells. Furthermore, it maintains a high static noise margin in all modes. This cell shows 45.5%, 42.78%, 20.77%, and 26.95% improvement for leakage power when compared to conventional6T, 8T, MG8T, and Kushwa 8T SRAM respectively. All the simulations are carried out at 1.2 V voltage supply, using CMOS 90nm technology. Hence, the PFC8T SRAM cell design is efficient for low-power applications.

articleTitle: An innovative wheelchair for quadreplegic patient using IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: There is a common type of paralysis in which the body below neck, legs and in some cases its arm, unable to move. Such condition is referred as quadriplegic and mainly occur due to spinal injury and as result the connecting nerve between brain and spinal cord get damaged. This Paper is based on an IoT enabled wheelchair for disabled persons. This discloses an innovative wheelchair for quadriplegia patient that controlled by hand gestures, motion. Self-mobility is achieved with the smart wheelchair and provides mechanical movement according to preprogrammed algorithm. Researchers all over the world are focusing at developing smart wheelchairs to solve problems faced by Quadriplegia patient. Other than normal functionality our research focuses on Inbuilt Alert system, health regulation system and Artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML) based path prediction system which makes this smart wheelchair design more Efficient and Safer.

articleTitle: Review and Performance Analysis of Inductorless Charge Pumps for Low-Power Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Charge pumps have long been the DC-DC converters of choice, especially in low-power and space-constrained applications where a part of the circuit requires a voltage different from what the source can supply. Charge pumps are often lauded for their relatively simple design, low cost, and exceptionally high efficiencies. The simplistic design can be attributed to the fact that it only requires a few discrete components or even single-chip solutions are available nowadays. Capacitors and switching devices form the fundamental operational part of these circuits. Specific variants are known to reach efficiencies above 95 percent, making them an excellent choice for modern designs. Before diving deeper and analyzing particular designs, this topic will briefly overview some standard topologies and their operating principles.

articleTitle: Design and analysis of a source pocket dual material hetero dielectric double gate TFET for improved performance
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: A source pocket dual material hetero dielectric double gate (SPDMHDDG) TFET structure is proposed in this work to improve tunneling current. An InGaAs material is used as a pocket in the source region near channel region to enhance the tunneling current. It has been found from the simulation that the proposed work increases on current to 10 times compared with Dual Material Hetero Dielectric Double Gate (DMHDDG) TFET structure. Further, the pocket length (LP), width (LW), and doping (NP) are optimized for optimum performance. It has been seen that at LP= 4nm, LW=12nm, and NP=1×1019 /cm3, the structure has maximum performance with on current and Subthreshold swing of 3.96×10-4 A/µm and 6.7 mV/decade, respectively.

articleTitle: Controlling the Ambipolar current by using Graded drain doped TFET
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: A Graded Doped Drain TFET (GD-TFET) architecture is proposed in this work to suppress the ambipolar current that exists in Conventional TFET (C-TFET). This graded doping in the drain region improves off-state parameters like off-current, ambipolar current without affecting on-state parameters. The various parameters from different TFET structures like Doping-Less TFET (DL-TFET), Low Doped TFET (LD-TFET), Conventional TFET (C-TFET), and Graded Doping TFET (GD-TFET) are simulated and compared. It has been found that the proposed architecture offers superior suppression of ambipolar current without affecting others parameters. The architecture offers an ambient current of 7×10<sup>-15</sup> A/μm which is far less than the other structure of 8×10 <sup>-10</sup> A/μm in the case of C-TFET. The structure also offers sub-threshold swing, transconductance, and on-to-off current ratio of 35.0628 mV/decade, 1.44×10<sup>-05</sup> S and 6.40×10<sup>+08</sup> A/μm, respectively, which is comparable to C-TFET structure.

articleTitle: Optimization of PV array with PID controller and MPPT(P&O)
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Due to depletion in fossil fuel resources, alternate energies are gaining importance. Further, adverse effects of global warming, increased installation and fuel costs of conventional energy sources in remote areas motivates to switch to suitable renewable resources including fuel cells, wind energy, photovoltaic cells etc. Such renewable energy resources are clean, pollution free and cost effective as compared to conventional fuels. Due to readily availability of the photovoltaic energy, it finds most usage. There is continuous rise in applications of photovoltaic (PV) solar panels, however the output voltage obtained from it is very low. Thus, there is need for suitable control technique to enhance the output voltage level. This paper presents the comparison of two techniques namely PID control and maximum power point tracking (MPPT) techniques for voltage enhancement of a PV panel. The MPPT technique utilizes perturb and observe (P&O) algorithm. The output results of Simulink models indicates that there is a substantial increase in output voltage with good stability by MPPT (P&O) technique.

articleTitle: Impact of Ge Mole Fraction on the Performance of Si1-xGex/InAs Charged Plasma-Based JLTFET
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: In this research article, we analyzed the importance of the Ge mole fraction (x) on the electrical performance of the Si<inf>1-x</inf>Ge<inf>x</inf>/InAs charged plasma-based junctionless TFET (JLTFET). In Si<inf>1-x</inf>Ge<inf>x</inf>/InAs JLTFET, we have used Si<inf>1-x</inf>Ge<inf>x</inf> at the source segment and InAs at the channel and drain segments on the basis of band gap engineering. The dependency of band energy, carrier concentration, I<inf>DS</inf> ~ V<inf>GS</inf> characteristics, I<inf>ON</inf>/I<inf>OFF</inf> ratio, electric field (E<inf>y</inf>), and transconductance (g<inf>m</inf>) on Ge mole fraction are analyzed in this research article. The simulated results depict that the device provides superior performance at the Ge mole composition (x = 0.1) and increment in the OFF-state current (I<inf>OFF</inf>) when we raise the Ge mole composition (x) in the Si<inf>1-x</inf>Ge<inf>x</inf> compound.

articleTitle: 4-trit CNFET-based Arithmetic Logic Unit
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: With the increase in advancement in chip technology, there is a great need for high-speed Arithmetic Logic Units (ALUs). These should also consume low power. One such technology which is coming into trend is Carbon Nanotube Field Effect Transistor (CNFET). CNFET is becoming popular because of its high speed and low power consumption properties. Ternary logics are now being preferred over binary logics because of several reasons such as high computational power for advanced technologies. The ternary logic uses three symbols, whereas binary logic uses only two symbols thereby it has higher processing capability. Some other advantage of CNFET based circuits is that only with fewer modifications in the existing CMOS-based designs, ternary logic design can easily be created. Simulation results in this work prove the fact that it has low power consumption and reduced delays, which is a milestone and will be useful for several applications apart from ALUs in future.

articleTitle: Steerable Pyramid-based Multi-Scale Fusion Algorithm for Single Image Dehazing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Multi-Scale Fusion Technique employs different versions of the image to be dehazed to extract haze-relevant parameters that aid in image dehazing. The paper proposes a variant of the technique using a Steerable Pyramid has been proposed. The proposed method extracts steer-coefficient matrices from the original hazy image and incorporates them into the multi-scale fusion algorithm. The proposed technique aims to reduce the halo effect observed in image-dehazing applications and related works. Moreover, this paper aims at the quality improvement of the output image by the novel algorithm it proposes. Quantitative, as well as a visual display of results, using the I-HAZE dataset, give an accurate interpretation of the effectiveness of the proposed work.

articleTitle: Based on RDWT and SVD Arnold Transform: A Strong and Secure Image Watermarking Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Originally, encryption techniques were used for owner authentication. Recently, digital image watermarking (DIW) presents a better scheme for copyright protection. This work presents a watermarking system based on singular value decomposition and hybrid redundant discrete wavelet transform. The technique includes fragmentation of cover image in four sub-bands. Arnold transform is used as a scrambling method which gives security to the proposed method. Watermarked image is undergoing through several attacks to find out the robustness. Experimental results show enhanced performance and better robustness of proposed scheme than existing scheme.

articleTitle: Implementation of Digital Applications Using Efficient CML based designs
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: This paper implements various digital applications of available efficient CML based designs. These digital applications can be used in mixed-signal processing blocks wherein high performance is required. These circuits have been implemented from the available efficient designs such as MTT cell based XOR gate, Quad Cell based XOR gate and MCML and PFSCL based tri-state circuits. Various digital applications wherein these designs are cascaded have been implemented such as 4-Bit RCA, 2:4 Decoder and Linear Feedback Shift Register (LFSR). Further, layouts of efficient CML designs have also been implemented in this paper.

articleTitle: Design Process of Wideband Power Amplifier In The L-Band Frequency Range
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: This paper talks about how the Advanced Design System (ADS) from Keysight has been used to design a wide- band class-AB power amplifier (PA). Wolfspeed’s CGH40025 is a non-linear model of a high electron mobility transistor (HEMT) made of gallium nitride (GaN) that has been used in this PA design. The operational frequency band of PA is 1.0–2.0 GHz, at a center frequency of 1.5 GHz. Load-pull analysis has been used to calculate the load and input impedance of a transistor to get the maximum output power. On Roger’s 4350B substrate, the prematching network & the output & input matching networks have been realized. With this design of PA, the received output power is greater than 41.5 dBm, the large signal gain is greater than 10 dB, and the power added efficiency (PAE) and drain efficiency (D<inf>eff</inf>) are greater than 50% over the complete operating frequency band. This PA’s primary application is in foliage penetration radar systems.

articleTitle: In-Memory Half Adder Computation using CNTFET Transistors in 8T SRAM
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: In modern applications as the transistor size is scaled down for high density chips, there are various limitations in CMOS such as mobility degradation, high leakage current, and higher standby power consumption. So, to overcome limitations imposed by CMOS, CNTFET is emerging as alternative option. The von-Neumann architecture is used in mostly all computing systems. In von-Neumann architecture, we must fetch data from memory to computer for computations and resend it to computer memory for further processing or storing. This causes large amount of energy consumption and delay in processing. To overcome the von-Neumann bottleneck, in-memory computation is being used nowadays. In the present work, first an in-memory computation circuit using virtual source carbon nanotube field-effect transistors (VS-CNTFET) in 8T SRAM is designed for improved performance. Next, a half adder circuit is also implemented and analyzed at different gate length of optimized VS-CNTFET using in-memory computation of NOR/NAND logics.

articleTitle: Efficient Centroid Based Distance Monitoring System Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: COVID-19 virus spread very rapidly if we come in contact to the other person who is infected, this was treated as acute pandemic. As per the data available at WHO more than 663 million infected cases reported and 6.7 million deaths are confirmed worldwide till Dec, 2022. On the basis of this big reported number, we can say that ignorance can cause harm to the people worldwide. Most of the people are vaccinated now but as per standard guideline of WHO social distancing is best practiced to avoid spreading of COVID-19 variants. This is difficult to monitor manually by analyzing the persons live cameras feed. Therefore, there is a need to develop an automated Artificial Intelligence based System that detects and track humans for monitoring. To accomplish this task, many deep learning models have been proposed to calculate distance among each pair of human objects detected in each frame. This paper presents an efficient deep learning monitoring system by considering distance as well as velocity of the object detected to avoid each frame processing to improve the computation complexity in term of frames/second. The detected human object closer to some allowed limit (1m) marked by red color and all other object marked with green color. The comparison of with and without direction consideration is presented and average efficiency found 20.08 FPS (frame/Second) and 22.98 FPS respectively, which is 14.44% faster as well as preserve the accuracy of detection.

articleTitle: Conventional Current Reference Generation Strategies for Grid-Connected Distributed Energy Sources
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Low voltage ride through (LVRT) is the ability of a photovoltaic (PV) system to maintain continuous operation during grid voltage dips or short-term power outages. To meet the LVRT requirements, PV systems typically include advanced inverter technology, energy storage systems, and additional protection devices. Current reference generation is a key aspect of LVRT technology, as it allows the inverter to maintain a stable current reference during voltage dips and outages. This is achieved by using advanced algorithms to control the inverter’s output current, and by incorporating voltage and frequency monitoring systems to detect grid disturbances. This research work reviews the performance of various current control systems under imbalanced grid faults and abrupt changes in irradiance. To confirm the behaviour of the current control mechanisms, simulation outcomes are shown.

articleTitle: High Gain, Compact Design Integrated With FSS As Superstrate In Patch Antenna For Sub6 Ghz 5G Application
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: In the field of radio engineering, an antenna is essential. A transmitter or receiver is used to connect the network between radio waves that travel across space and electric currents that travel via metal conductors. In 1953, the first patch antenna was created. However, because of their positive characteristics, such as low profile, affordable production, lightweight, and simple installation, they also became the researcher's focus area. This study indicates a compact rectangle-shaped microstrip patch antenna. Very first a rectangular shape patch antenna together with dimensions of 30x35 mm<sup>2</sup> at 6 GHz is created utilizing an Fr4 substrate with 4.4 permittivity and a height of 1.6 mm. The simulated result showed an acceptable reflection coefficient, VSWR, and high gain with the integration of the FSS layer as a superstrate. FR4 material is used to create a unit cell for an FSS periodic structure with a 6x7 array. The simulated outcome displays a broad bandwidth between 3.2 GHz to 6.5 GHz with an increase in gain from 4 dB to 7.5 db.

articleTitle: Spatial Channel Attention based Change Detection in Synthetic Aperture Radar Images
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Change Detection (CD) in Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) images is a key research field in remote sensing. Recently, CD in SAR images has received more attention due to the availability of SAR images, irrespective of weather conditions. However, it is difficult to exploit the changed information from SAR images, as these are subject to speckle noise. In this work, a Spatial Channel Attention (SCA) based CD network (SCACDNet) has been proposed. The SCACDNet is designed by integrating convolution neural network with the SCA module. Initially, the two SAR images are preprocessed and then, difference image is produced using the Log-Ratio operator. Then, the hierarchical fuzzy c-means clustering is used to classify the pixels into unchanged, changed and fuzzy classes. Now, image patches around highly probable unchanged and changed pixels are fed as an input to the network. After training, the pixels belong to fuzzy class are classified by the SCACDNet to produce a change map. The quantitative and qualitative results obtained for three SAR datasets demonstrate the superior performance of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Security in Internet of Things: An Overview
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoTs) has been one of the innovations that have gained the most traction in recent years across a range of applications. For communications, analysis, computation, and monitoring of various environments, the smart devices are wired/wirelessly connected. The items are diverse, have little storage, and become less powerful. Since traditional-based existing security mechanisms are incompatible with the IoTs, implementing the IoTs system poses security and privacy issues.In this article, in-depth layer-by-layer identification of the security concerns in the IoTs system is done. A thorough analysis of related technologies, including blockchain incorporation with the IoTs security, artificial intelligence, and machine learning, is conducted. In the study of this survey’s findings, security issues resolved by machine learning, artificial intelligence, and blockchain technology are mentioned along with challenging issues.

articleTitle: Time Series Anomaly Detection System with Linear Neural Network and Autoencoder
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: The methodical compliances of time series data have been acclimated for digitalization in ultramodern industrial processes. Artificial implanted detectors produce unknown streaming data which is available for dimensional reduction. The proposed reduction step exploits autoencoders infrequently combined with direct neural networks. The decentralized machine learning based monitoring detectors are equipped to capture bitsy changes in the product schedule. The monitoring detectors descry multi-dimensional changes in the product outfit of N-dimensional time series. The traditional anomaly detection methods are changeable in real-time industrial-based time series data. We propose a multidimensional, effective, and decentralized machine learning based anomaly detection system for industrial high dimensional product schedules in this paper. The experimental setup is designed to map multidimensional reduction from time series data. The proposed decentralized system improves calculation time and effective anomaly detection can be employed for processing real- time industrial data.

articleTitle: Isolation Enhancement in a Two-Element MIMO Antenna Using Electromagnetic Metamaterial
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: In this manuscript, a planar, uni-layer two-port multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) antenna covering the n77/78/79 5G bands is presented. An elliptical-shaped artificial metamaterial structure is used as a decoupling structure to restrict surface current and improve isolation between MIMO antenna elements. The prospective MIMO antenna element is made up of a slotted monopole, 50-ohm feeding line, and a partial ground conductor. For miniaturization, an inverted T-shaped slot is loaded on the radiator of the unit cell. The effective material properties of the suggested ellipse-shaped artificial material are estimated to assess its metamaterial behavior. The proposed MIMO antenna operates from 3300 MHz to 5000 MHz, covering the n77/78/79 5G frequencies. The performance of the presented 5G MIMO antenna is validated using the CST Microwave Studio and Ansys HFSS EM tools.

articleTitle: The Enhancement in Road Safety using Different Image Detection and Recognition Techniques: - A State of Art
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Over the last 10 years, researchers and developers shows a significant evolution in the development of intelligent transport systems (ITS) i.e. self-driving cars. One of the challenging issues that researchers are faced with these systems is the detection and recognition of traffic signs. Using computer vision to identify, detect, and classify objects (such as traffic signs) is a problem that is currently difficult to solve. Traffic signs serve a prominent role in protecting drivers and pedestrians from deadly threats that occur due to accidents. There are more than 4000 accidents occur every day in a country that drops 3% GDP of the nation yearly. There have been numerous studies carried out using computer vision for automatic Traffic Sign Detection and Recognition (TSDR) which produced good results. In this paper, the author studied various object detection models.

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection in Image Processing using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Any method that looks for samples that deviate from anticipated patterns is sometimes referred to as anomaly detection. Many outlier finding methods are established on the types of irregularities, various types of data labels that are available, and the applications. The aim of this paper is to give an overview and systematic evaluation of outlier finding research. We believe that the paper contributes to a better understanding of the numerous fields in various types of research done on this subject. The approaches for anomaly detection have been separated into many groups. We discuss the pros and cons of each category and look at how computationally complex the various methods are in terms of real-world application domains. We concluded the paper by providing research gaps and constraints we faced while applying artificial intelligence algorithms in practical applications. This review paper examines several outlier detection and treatment techniques in images, as well as gives better performance of various AI approaches.

articleTitle: Detection of Lung Disease using an Efficient Image Classification Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Image classification is an area of research and exploration. Many researchers and scientists have been trying to find better and more efficient methods for various respective fields. But still, a lot of work is being done and yet to be done in this vast area. We have proposed a technique that uses the two points, i.e., feature subset selection and classification. An embedded model is proposed having a feature subset selection strategy and classification strategy. A lung cancer data set is attained from the UCI repository for analyzing the results. The first size of the initial feature set is reduced using feature selection techniques and then a classification strategy is applied to the attained reduced feature set to achieve good performance.

articleTitle: Vector Auto-Regression-Based Predictive model for Smart Meter
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: The rising cost of electricity is becoming a significant burden for many households. To address this issue, there is now a growing interest in the development of smart meters as monitors and controllers for electricity that can be used both in smart homes as well as further in smart cities. For example, using air conditioning in hot climates and geysers in winter can significantly increase electricity bills. To address this issue, this paper proposes a predictive model, Vector Auto regression (Vector Auto regression) (VAR) approach to anticipate electricity consumption and management using weather data based on hourly four different modules. By analyzing a dataset of various household appliance readings and corresponding weather conditions, the proposed method can predict electricity consumption with a correlation coefficient of 0.95 using the VAR method. This paper discusses the implementation possibility of predicting energy generation and consumption within 21st-century energy meters that are fully automated, manageable, and more efficient including robust capabilities of home Area Networks. After analyzing the results, this study provides a strong foundation for the prediction of accurate smart electricity consumption that can help households to predict and manage their electricity usage by regulating the use of energy-intensive appliances based on various weather conditions. We also calculate the mean absolute error during the period.

articleTitle: Plant Leaf Disease Classification using Convolutional Neural Network on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Leaf damage due to disease is a major source of concern for farmers. India’s agriculture-based economy accounts for a considerable share of the country’s GDP. This research proposes the utilization of a machine learning based model on different leaf images to detect the disease of four different types of plants which includes Apple, Maize, Potato and Tomato. A Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model is used to categorize the kind of disease affecting the leaf, which is trained by using the Plant Village dataset. This trained model is deployed on AMD Xilinx’s Kria KV260 FPGA using Vitis AI for the identification of the disease. The accuracy of disease classification achieved is around 98.04%.

articleTitle: Mammographic mass Classification using DL based ROI segmentation and ML based Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Mammography is said to be the initial examination for analysis of breast cancer masses in women at the age of 38 or above. Breast cancer masses may be benign or malignant. Various CAD systems have been designed to differentiate benign and malignant breast cancer masses. Breast cancer masses can be easily classified as benign or malignant considering their features. Features from mammographic images can be efficiently extracted using shape and texture features. Both the shape and texture features contribute a vital role in the classification of mammographic masses. Enormous Computer-assisted design systems have been employed for the classification of masses in mammographic images. In the present research work, the performance of the CAD system with DL based ROI segmentation and ML based mass classification of SFM mammographic images has been analyzed using 518 mammographic images from the DDSM dataset. DL based encode-decoder segmentation model ResNet50 is used for ROI segmentation. The shape and texture feature sets are extracted and concatenated, yielding a combined feature set to be fed to ML based classifiers namely ANFC-LH and PCA-SVM for binary classification of mammographic masses. The ANFC-LH and PCA-SVM classifier yields 73.0 % and 72.0 %, accuracy for the binary classification of SFM mass images.

articleTitle: Ring Oscillators based All Digital Phase Locked Loop: A Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: A phase-locked loop system (PLL) is a circuit in which the output signal’s amplitude and frequency are supposed to lock with the input reference signal. Analog or digital methods can be used to construct a phase-locked loop. Due to the constant scaling down of CMOS technology, it is now advantageous to implement digital phase-locked loop devices (DPLL) because digital designs suit modern technology needs such as low power consumption, small size, and the manufacturing of integrated circuits on small chips. Unlike an analog system, which is difficult to modify, digital design characteristics can be simply changed to meet the needs of the system. This study investigates all-digital phase-locked loop systems (ADPLL), which are more scalable, portable, have a faster lock time, and are employed in most applications. The different ways of implementing a digital control oscillator and phase detector are investigated to explore the multistage designs for specific applications.

articleTitle: A Study on Intensity of Sound Waves for Variable Frequency
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Smart phones have a positive effect on students’ interest and curiosity. The current research focuses on "A study on sound intensity for variable frequency." Sensors in smart phones give the best possible result in a physics experiment. To record experimental data, internal sensors like audio amplitude and a tone generator are used in the "Phyphox" application, which was specifically designed to make experiments easy. The intensity of sound for a female voice can be measured by using a pair of smart phones, where one smart phone acts as a source (to generate frequency) and the other is used to measure intensity. The source phone is at one end of the scale, and the detected phone is 1 cm away from it; both are along the X-axis. Similarly, results for the Y and Z axes are obtained. In this manuscript, we used the frequencies from 165 Hz to 210 Hz. The results are shown in graphs. As the frequency is increasing, the value of the sound pressure is showing different changes.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Wireless Fading Channels for Indoor Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Channels play a significant role in wireless communication systems. Such systems utilize modulation techniques in enhancing the signal strength or range. However, different channels are preferred for specific data transmission. Interference, bandwidth, modulation order and transmitted power are some of the parameters that directly affect Bit Error Rate (BER) and Signal to Noise Ratio (SNR) during signal transmission in the channel. This paper overviews on the performance evaluation of wireless fading channels, causes of fading and digital modulation scheme. Here Binary Phase Shift Keying (BPSK) is chosen by considering it to be a preliminary modulation scheme. The main contribution deals with analyzing the performance of small-scale fading in Additive White Gaussian Noise (AWGN), Rayleigh and Rician fading channels. The performance metrics considered are SNR(E<inf>b</inf>/N<inf>o</inf>) and BER. All the simulations are carried out using MATLAB tool.

articleTitle: Improved Channel Model of UAV to UAV Millimeter Wave Link Under Hovering Fluctuations and Doppler Effect
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: UAV-enabled mmWave communication system has the potential to provide increased bandwidth and transmission speed than traditional wireless communications. However, mmWave signals suffer challenges with propagation. UAV’s versatility in the field of communication may overcome most of mmWave’s shortcomings, sustain its benefits, and open up new prospects. In this paper, an existing channel model of a UAV-based millimeter wave communication system has been improved for a direct UAV-to-UAV link in which the source and destination are moving UAVs by considering the doppler effect. The reliability of the system is then evaluated on the basis of outage probability for both SINR and SNR regimes. It is shown that the interference due to the Doppler effect of moving UAVs has a significant impact on the performance of such networks. Finally, system performance is verified by Monte Carlo simulation and shown that the SINR regime fits more accurately with the simulation results than the SNR regime.

articleTitle: A novel Compact RHCP Antenna with wide 3 dB AR bandwidth for S-band IRNSS application
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: The compact Right Hand Circularly Polarized (RHCP) Microstrip Patch Antennas (MPA) over the novel Reactive Impedance Surface (RIS) based metasubstrate has been designed and analyzed exclusively for the S-band navigational satellite system application. The RHCP radiation is achieved for single S-band frequency (2.492 GHz) by placing uniquely corner truncated square patch over the novel design structure of RIS substrate. The proposed low-cost compact antenna prototype achieves 10 dB return loss bandwidths (RLBW) of 14.05% and 3 dB Axial Ratio Bandwidth (ARBW) of 4.01% at S band frequency. The cross-polar discrimination (XPD) of 16.85 dB along with wide 3 dB axial ratio beamwidth of 135° at targeted frequency band indicate highly effective RHCP operation. It is the most compact antenna ever reported in S-band with overall electric size of 0.28λ<inf>0</inf> × 0.28λ<inf>0</inf> × 0.03λ<inf>0</inf> and can serve as a viable option for a compact RHCP receiver antenna for navigational system.

articleTitle: Algorithm Trading through Application Programming Interface (API) in Indian Stock Market
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Algorithmic Trading (AT) is a process to execute orders using automated and preprogrammed trading instruction by using Price, Timing and Volume as a variable. Algorithms are designed by approved vendors which work on past data for achieving set objectives. A human emotion free decision taken through ATs. AT came in India in 2008, initially institutional investors started trading with AT, retail investors adopted AT in last couple of years. Indian stock market regulator SEBI trying to protect investors from harms of AT. In recent past SEBI has also released a consultation paper on algorithmic trading by retail investors dated on Dec 19, 2021.This study is examining the current status and strategic analysis of algorithm trading w.r.t to Application Programming (API) algorithm trading in Indian stock market. This study will be useful for all investors using AT or planning to use AT. It will also be helpful for policy makers to frame futuristic policies on algorithmic trading.

articleTitle: Applications of IoT in Retail: A Systematic Review
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Research on Internet of Things (IoT) in retail was initiated in 1998 and since then a large number of applications of IoT in retail industry has been explored. This study focuses on analyzing the previous research work accepted in the area of application of IoT in retail sector. The findings of this study provide information about the rise in the number of research work as well as its citations with the help of bibliometric analysis. The online Scopus enquire resulted in 583 documents. Maximum publications were in conferences proceedings and journals. Most of the research related to IoT in retail was led in India and China and was multi-authored having an average collaboration index of 3.22 authors/article. The current work shows the development of the research work related to the application of IoT in retail and recognizes extents of existing research and suggests the directions for upcoming work.

articleTitle: VLSI Architectures for Video Salient Object Detection using 3D Dual Tree Complex Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Detection of Salient objects in image and video sequences are very interesting and rewarding task which is the crux of many applications that deal with computer vision. Salient objects are segmented from the objects of interest and are correlated with objects in its neighborhood which is similar to the cognitive property of human visual system. Major distinction of using complex wavelets in the process of salient object detection lies in the fact that the complex wavelets have the directional selectivity property. Systolic Array and Distributive architectures are considered for the detection of salient objects in the video sequence using 3D DTCWT. The proposed work are implemented on SPARTAN 6 FPGA and tested in the XILINX.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation of FiWi based OCDMA system
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Optical fiber cable is lacking to communicate over various geographical restriction areas at less cost, long distance and high bandwidth. To minimize the fiber installation cost, a hybrid fiber-wireless (FiWi) link can be used to improve the flexibility and system bandwidth in diverse areas to connect anywhere and anytime with end users. Thus in this work a hybrid FiWi based optical code division multiple access (OCDMA) system using modified new zero cross correlation (MNZCC) code at 40Gbps data rate has been presented. The results depict that the system offers 4000m wireless as well as 40km wired range with high security. Additionally, the proposed design is an optimum than other previous works.

articleTitle: 10-bit SAR ADC for Biomedical Sensor Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: The need for battery powered wearable gadgets has risen dramatically as the healthcare system has progressed. Unfortunately, these bio-medical signals are analog in nature and needs to be transformed to digital form before further processing. In a bio-medical sensor system, the bio-medical signal is first given to an analog front-end to raise signal amplitude and pre-process it. Later, it is converted in digital form to make use of digital signal processors (DSPs) with the help of analog to digital converter (ADC). One of the main blocks of ADC is SAR logic which uses D flip flops for realization. In this paper, a new logic ("D Logic") has been proposed which reduces the number of transistors required to implement the SAR logic by 18.53%, as well as power dissipation. The 10-bit ADC has been designed in 90 nm CMOS process using Cadence Virtuoso. The overall power consumption of the proposed SAR ADC is 67.53 µW.

articleTitle: Monitoring flash flood using Optical and Microwave Sensor dataset:- A case study of Cachar district, Assam (India)
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Flash flood is one of the world’s most devastating and repeated natural hazards which severely damage the infrastructure and livelihood and also displaced millions of people each year. It is the most widespread hydrological hazard worldwide, impacting various ecological elements and applications associated with water management, natural resources, agriculture, human health, and economics. Flood damage assessment is crucial in gauging damage and estimating economic loss due to floods. The current practice of flood crop loss evaluation has become laborious, very generalized, and overlong due to the dependency survey-primarily based information collection. Remote sensing data availability makes expeditive flood loss assessment possible. Sentinel-1C-Band SAR (Synthetic Aperture Rader) and Sentinel 2 data collected from the ESA (European Space Agency) of the study area during the flooded period were analysed using geospatial techniques. The data sets used for the study were collected during the flood and were processed using Sentinel Toolbox in SNAP.

articleTitle: Distribution of Nanomachines over Nano-networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Molecular Communication is a new vertical in the modern communication system in which molecules are used in exchange of information. As the information molecules travel from transmitter to receiver through the diffusion process, they undergo various impairments. However, molecular density or in turn total number of received molecules ensure faithful communication. On the other hand, the molecular density is a probabilistic quantity and given by probability density function (PDF). In literature, various PDFs are used to quantify the molecular density and number of received molecules. In sequence, this paper presents molecular density under different PDFs. It is noteworthy to mention that the Levy distribution is the most stable function to represent particles in the Brownian motion. Whereas IG distribution is generic in nature. In particular, we have considered Inverse Gaussian (IG) distribution and Levy distribution function to evaluate the molecular density under different scenarios. The simulation shows perfect agreement with the theoretical background.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of High-k Dielectric Junction less FET for Reduction of Subthreshold Leakage Current
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: With the purpose of reduction of the subthreshold leakage current, high-k dielectric material is used, as this work demonstrates. The because of high leakage current and a sharp rise in tunneling, SiO<inf>2</inf> conventional MOSFET feature sizes have reached their physical limits, where reducing the oxide thickness below 2nm become not possible. Because of this, it is challenging to reduce MOSFET size and increase performance at the same time. Transistor parameters like oxide thickness channel length, and channel width can be altered instead of the transistor’s size being shrunk. The device’s performance could be impacted by these, though. Therefore, the impact of substituting another high permittivity material for SiO<inf>2</inf> has been studied. SiO<inf>2</inf>, Al<inf>2</inf>O<inf>3</inf>, HfO<inf>2</inf>, Ta<inf>2</inf>O<inf>5</inf>, and La<inf>2</inf>O<inf>3</inf> were among the materials employed in the analysis. SILVACO TCAD simulation was used to test the characteristic of subthreshold leakage current.

articleTitle: Using the Indian MST Radar Noise-Level Observations of Stratosphere-Troposphere Replace were made over the tropical station Gadanki
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: The mesosphere stratosphere-troposphere radar at Gadanki was used to record the climates of stratosphere disturbance into the tropospheric through the Indian Summer Monsoon. The existence of an enhanced signal-to-noise ratio of 3 dB and measurement powers complete supernatural size of greater than 0.2 ms<sup>-1</sup> in the locality of the troposphere through the Indian Summer Monsoon is the most important and novel observation. From April to June, downdrafts (updrafts) predominate near the tropopause (July to March). The ten years of ozone dimensions from the five years of in-situ ozonesonde explanation also support the outcome of stratosphere air intrusion. A thorough analysis reveals that the tropical easterly jet's turbulence near the tropopause, horizontal advection, and troposphere height changeability is the leading candidate for ozone ship from the stratospheric to the tropospheric. In contrast, during the ISM, the tropical troposphere heat has an important impact on the carrying of water steam from the tropopause to the stratopause. The idea of the present revision is to use Indian MST radar to qualitatively construct the climate of these replace processes over Gadanki.

articleTitle: Dimensionality Reduction of Multivariate Images Using the Linear & Nonlinear Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Multivariate imaging advanced in recent years which prompted many applications for detailed understanding in the fields of satellite imaging, medical imaging, and microscopic imaging. To achieve more insights about it, various feature extraction techniques exist which utilize the ample spectral and spatial details in an image. But apart from feature extraction dimensionality reduction (DR) and efficient classification has become a key aspect in multivariate image analysis (MIA). Adding more and more variables in feature space of multivariate image results into high dimensionality which in turn increases the complexity in classification. Therefore, it becomes important to apply DR techniques before classification process. Most widely used DR method is Principal component analysis (PCA) which is linear DR method. The main disadvantage of PCA is that it does not consider the nonlinearity in data. Local linear embedding (LLE) overcomes nonlinearity issue. This paper presents comparative approach for DR of multivariate image using PCA and LLE.

articleTitle: EfficientNet-based Image Captioning System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: An individual might take an instant glimpse of an image or environment and express it quite precisely and effectively. Image captioning i.e., automatic labelling of images is a well-known complex problem in the area of image processing. The rationale for this is because the convergence of Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Computer Vision (CV) should be capable of developing and providing the mankind with an appropriate depiction of a picture. In this study, we attempt to develop an EfficientNet-based model that requires fewer characteristics and produces excellent predictions. We utilise the very famous and well-known MSCOCO Dataset i.e., Microsoft Common Objects in Context, which includes near about 330K pictures, 1.5M object instances, and 80 different classifications of objects. We use the BLEU-4 scoring for the analysis of the system, that specifies how close the predicted caption is to the reference caption. Having BLEU score nearer to 1 denotes more comparable captions. The suggested approach comprehends the picture efficiently and produces more intended outcomes.

articleTitle: Conformal UWB Antenna with enhanced gain characteristics using Mu-Negative Metamaterial
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Here, a compact conformal Ultra-Wide Band (UWB) antenna is designed having CPW feed arrangement and integrated with mu-negative (MNG) metamaterial structure to enhance its radiation characteristics. Initially, a CPW-fed UWB antenna with dimensions of 50 mm × 44 mm is designed, optimized, and simulated using a 0.25 mm FR4 substrate. Next, a meta cell is developed on same conformal FR4 substrate material that exhibits two magnetic resonance regions ranging from 4.8 to 6.5 and 10.3 to 11.7 and further exhibiting stop band attenuation of -5.1 dB with maximum MNG of -104.9 at 5.3 GHz. Further, an (5 × 5) array of designed metasurface unit cell is formed to be employed as a ground plane underneath the flexible UWB antenna design resulting in improving its achievable bandwidth, radiation characteristics and antenna gain. Working of integrated, conformal UWB antenna structure with unit cell is evaluated by optimizing the air gap distance between them. The optimized, integrated antenna performance exhibits an impedance bandwidth of 13.5 GHz covering the entire UWB band with a maximum gain of 9.1 dB validating a suitable candidate for healthcare monitoring and other wearable applications.

articleTitle: VGG-16 based Gait Recognition using Skeleton Features
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Gait recognition is a new technology that can identify people with various walking patterns. Gait of a person is the manner in which they walk. A person’s walking stride is distinctive due to their body movements. Due to the popularity of the Kinect, human gait can be recognised to using 3D skeletal information. In this paper, Skeleton Gait Energy(SkeGEI) is image-based approach for gait recognition and VGG-16 with multilayer perceptron is proposed to effectively exploit raw depth information collected by the Kinect sensor. To restore as much gait data as possible, fine-tuned VGG-16 is used to extract space - time deep feature data from SkeGEI. Multilayer perceptron is then used to ascertain the connection between the corresponding subject and the gait features. Softmax is used for classification. Experiments on three different datasets show that our technique outclasses the majority of gait recognition methods.

articleTitle: Absorber Layer Doping Concentration Optimization of Lead-Free Cs2CuSbCl6 Perovskite Solar Cells for Improved Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: In this work, the doping concentration of absorber layer has been optimized on lead-free perovskite (Cs<inf>2</inf>CuSbCl<inf>6</inf>-based) solar cells for improved power conversion efficiency. Cs<inf>2</inf>CuSbCl<inf>6</inf> is a non-toxic material with high durability having a band gap of 1.66 eV. Cs<inf>2</inf>CuSbCl<inf>6</inf> shows higher efficiency owing to higher absorption of photons using SCAPS-1D. The optimization of absorber layer doping concentration is performed in terms of energy band profile, quantum efficiency, and current density. Further, the optimization of absorber layer doping concentration has also been performed in terms of various performance parameters of the photovoltaic cell. The proposed (ITO/TiO<inf>2</inf>/Cs<inf>2</inf>CuSbCl<inf>6</inf>/Spiro-OMeTAD/Au) perovskite solar cells reflect 27.31% efficiency for the optimized absorber layer doping concentration of 1×10<sup>22</sup> cm<sup>-3</sup>. For the same absorber layer doping concentration V<inf>oc</inf> = 1.64 V, J<inf>sc</inf> = 18.44 mA/cm<sup>2</sup>, and FF = 89.79% have been achieved.

articleTitle: Recent Advancements in Structural Health Monitoring using Optical Sensor
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Civil structure monitoring is a mandatory field of research now a days due to the adverse effects of environmental change on the civil structures for various industries. Optical sensing is a well-established field in structural monitoring, however recent advancements in fiber sensing technique are marvelous and open new possibilities of better monitoring. In this study these advancements are reviewed based on the materials used in optical sensors.
