articleTitle: A Wideband Circularly Polarized CSRR Loaded Patch Antenna for ISM And C-Band Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: In this work, a wideband CPW-fed T-shaped circularly polarized patch antenna is reported. A complementary split ring resonator (CSRR) metamaterial unit cell is loaded on the ground plane to enhance the axial ratio bandwidth for having circular polarization. The overall dimension of the antenna is 50x50x1.6 mm<sup>3</sup>, which is a compact structure. Simulated impedance bandwidth below -10 dB is from 2.2 GHz to 7.75 GHz (113%), which covers the frequency ranges of the ISM band, the IMT band, and WiFi 6/6E. It also has circular polarization in IMT band 2 (4.4–4.9 GHz) and WiFi 6/6E (5.925–6.425GHz). The average gain of the patch antenna over the entire range is around 4 dBi.

articleTitle: Study of Tsallis Distribution of Plasma inside Paul Trap using 3D Color-Map Plots
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Using 3D color-map plots we study the behavior of the time evolution of the velocity distribution function of Plasma confined in a Paul trap by assuming the distribution to be q-Gaussian. The q-Gaussian distribution is a type of Tsallis distribution that generalizes the Gaussian distribution and gives a more accurate description of the statistics of Plasma than the Gaussian distribution. From the 3D color-map plots we see that for specific values of system scale factor the time evolution of the distribution function is periodic, otherwise it is generally non-periodic. We also study the 3D color-map plots of the initial q-Gaussian distribution for different values of the parameter q and see the change in color-map of the initial q-Gaussian distribution with increasing values of q.

articleTitle: Performance Assessment of Multivariate Statistical and Bagging Ensembles in Landslide Susceptibility Mapping: Case Study of National Highway-10
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: One of the major natural disasters that take place on earth is landslide, which can happen naturally or as a result of human activity. In mountainous and hilly terrain, landslides, which can be fatal, are more frequent. To prevent the loss of life and minimize economic loss, the two main repercussions of the deadly calamity, susceptibility assessments and the identification of probable landslide zones become essential. The current study aims to provide a comprehensive performance assessment of a multivariate statistical technique and a bagging ensemble for landslide susceptibility mapping along the NH-10, which has an approximate expansion of 51.5 kms from Sivok Khola to Rangpoo. In total, 309 landslide sites were identified and divided randomly into training and testing data with 70:30 ratio. The prepared susceptibility maps were validated and substantiated through the receiver operating characteristics curve, which showed bagging ensemble performed better.

articleTitle: A Unique Metaheuristic Algorithm for Human Urbanisation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: In the past ten years, there has been a rise in the popularity of metaheuristic algorithms, which make use of heuristic methods in order to find optimal solutions. Additionally, many distinct algorithms that are inspired by nature have been developed in order to improve the quality of solutions and the rate at which they converge. The author of this piece suggests a novel metaheuristic search for optimization that is based on human behaviour, with the intention of easing the transition to urban living and improving people's overall quality of life. In order to locate the intended outcome, this algorithm makes use of a wide range of search strategies, including population management and agent concentration, open and limited scope combination searching, and many more. The suggested method outperforms more strong algorithms already in use in the majority of search domains, as shown by the results of a number of different assessments using a range of different test functions.

articleTitle: Improving Pronunciation of the Students of Uttarakhand Region Using Pre-Defined Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Proper Pronunciation is essential for a successful career. In the present era, recruiters do not want mug pots or rote learners i.e one that scores well in the technical or the core area. The need of the hour demands a holistic personality which must include good communication skills, critical thinking, managerial skills & logical reasoning. In the present study, the researchers have studied the mother tongue influence (MTI) in the English language spoken by the regional speakers of the Kumaun region. In the present study, the researchers have observed that the students of Uttarakhand have high MTI (Mother Tongue Influence) which is noticeable in their communication. They face difficulty in articulation of certain consonant sounds like sh (ꭍ), v, w, etc. Words like sheep /ꭍi:p/ are mispronounced as seep /si:p/, career/kₔriₔ/ as carrier /kᵆriₔ/ (Kay-rier). Due to poor pronunciation, they face challenges not only in the recruitment process but also in survival in Multi-National Companies where the American / British accent is widely used. The researchers conducted a diagnostic test to identify the extent and frequency of flaws in the articulation of words. It was observed that the performance of the regional learners was poor and required improvement. They implemented a Pre-Defined Algorithm model for improving the performance of the regional students. It was followed by a post-implementation test which was conducted through the proposed model. The proposed model has a better outcome concerning reducing the MTI in general pronunciation of the English Language among Kumauoni speakers of Uttarakhand.

articleTitle: Integrating Global and Local Features for Efficient Face Identification Using Deep CNN Classifier
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: This work analyses the effectiveness of integrating global (complete face) and local (eyes, nose, mouth part) features for face identification using deep CNN classifier for different percentage of training dataset and different number of users. In this work, we have used HOG for face detection followed by DHE technique for image enhancement as low-illumination image contain important distinct facial features. The role of global and local features in perceiving a face is distinct and substantial. Thus, to examine the efficacy we have extracted and integrated the global feature (DCT) with local feature (ULBP) as the proposed facial feature. For dimensionality reduction of DCT-ULBP feature, 2DPCA is used. The reduced feature vectors are fed to deep CNN classifier for face identification task. The experimental result on ORL face database, shows that the proposed features are discriminative and complement with each other. The proposed DCT-ULBP feature with deep CNN helps us to achieve an accuracy of 94.58% and outperforms the contemporary DCT and ULBP feature extraction techniques.

articleTitle: Ensemble Approach to Solve Multiple Skin Disease Classification Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Skin lesions ailments are among the most prominent problems. Despite its ubiquity, skin disease diagnosis is strenuous due to the intricacies of the lesion's location, the skin's texture, and whether or not there is hair. More than 1000 skin issues have been identified, ranging from acne to herpes and severe inflammatory conditions, and many of these conditions significantly degrade the quality of life. The model mentioned was able to get an accuracy of 69 ± 1 % also the ensemble model which is proposed uses VGG 16 and Efficient Net(B3) and applied Stacking to the model. Using data from the Dermnet and HAM10000 datasets, this study investigates the feasibility of deep learning for detecting 23 different types of skin disorders. In addition to predicting the disease accurately, it is also focused on providing the severity and the general locale of the disease and is providing analysis with the help of our Summarized Report to determine which architecture performs the best, which are contrasted.

articleTitle: Comparing Classifiers for Recognizing the Emotions by extracting the Spectral Features of Speech Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Speech has been a crucial form of communication from the dawn of humanity. Natural verbal communication must include emotions. The voice is a poor indicator of human emotion for machines. A machine must first understand the acoustic capabilities of the human ear in order to understand human behaviour. The addition of emotion processing enhances the realism and significance of the current speech systems. The classification of the voice signal relies heavily on spectral properties. To accomplish emotion classification, spectral information from speech, such as Mel Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCC), Linear Prediction Cepstral Coefficients (LPC) and pitch are retrieved in this study. We compared the different algorithm to choose CatBoost as a classifier. For training and testing purposes, a speech emotion database with more than one hundred people in a range of emotions is employed. From the numerous movie clips, another real-life emotion speech database is also employed.

articleTitle: Effect of channel Variation on DC Performance parameters of MOS and DTMOS technologies
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: The design of analog circuits itself has advanced together with the performance requirements and technology. With device dimensions shrinking, the supply voltage of integrated circuits also drops. This paper brings the effect of channel variation (length and width) on DC performance parameters (threshold voltage, power dissipation, transconductance, resistance and βeffective) of MOS and DTMOS technologies. The discussed circuits have been simulated using the Cadence Virtuoso tool in 90nm technology. The DTMOS transistors are turned on with lower threshold voltage leading to lower power dissipation and threshold voltage as compared to MOS transistors. Carrier mobility is affected by the channel length and width variations.

articleTitle: Performance of CNN for different facial expression images with varying input dataset sizes
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Image classification is one of the computer vision problems. It is a supervised learning technique, in this, images are classified according to their different characteristics (features). There are various facial image datasets of different persons with different facial expressions. Classification based on different facial expressions is always a challenging task for researchers because a person can have different facial expressions like smiling, sad, normal, with or without goggles, etc., depending upon the mood of the person. Deep learning technique like Convolutional neural networks (CNN) is an indemand technique to classify images based on their features. This paper demonstrates the performance of CNN using a different number of images with different numbers of expressions per person and keeping all the other parameters the same. For performance measurement of CNN, the faces94 dataset of is used. Based on the evaluated results, some important points are highlighted.

articleTitle: Enhancement of Security Posture in Smart Farming: Challenges and Proposed Solution
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Smart farming is a concept that integrate farming with technology where the main focus is on industrial automation with the latest IT infrastructure including internet of things (IoT), Robotics, Blockchain, Machine Learning for monitoring and analyzing farming activities. While agricultural industry is moving rapidly towards smart farming ecosystem, it is also creating new attack surface for threat actors. These cyber-attacks can disrupt the food supply chain and can affect the quality and production. In this paper, we study the latest technologies adopted in smart farming and possible cyber threats on smart farming ecosystem. We also propose a model for secure smart farming that not only enhance the overall security posture of this sector but also educate the end user (through Honeypots deployments) about the possible attack pattern and method of propagation adopted by cyber criminals.

articleTitle: Analysis of Organic Thin Film Transistor based ALU
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Organic thin film transistors (OTFTs) are becoming more popular due to their special characteristics such as flexibility, low temperature, and lightweight. In this research, the performance of some logic circuits designed by using the p-type OTFT (pOTFT) and also complementary OTFT (pnOTFT) are investigated. Extensive simulation results show that the circuits designed by using complementary OTFT are more competent as compared to the other model in terms of power dissipation. However, the time delays for various simple arithmetic operations are almost similar.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Mel Frequency Cepstral Coefficients and Bayesian Gaussian Mixure Model for Voice based Authentication Websites
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Consumers of today can interact with technology to complete a variety of simple tasks using voice recognition, a new technology. Because of advancements in technology, voice recognition systems help identify people by their speech. It provides quick and extremely secure identification and authentication with a minimum of speech. Create a voice-based website authentication system that is user-friendly as part of this research to access websites. As part of the registration process, users' speech signals are initially gathered for this study. It is recommended that the Hybrid Mel Frequency Cepstral Coefficients and Bayesian Gaussian Mixture Model be used to train the speech authentication system (HMFCC-BGMM). In this instance, features from the voice are extracted using MFCC, and the system is trained using BGMM. According to the experimental findings, the proposed HMFCC-BGMM has a high accuracy of 94.5% and a lower error rate than previous models.

articleTitle: Bibliometric Analysis of White- Collar crimes- Concept and Development Using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Over the past few years, the globalization of white-collar crimes has increased, making it more challenging for law enforcement agencies to prevent such offenses. This topic has become one of the most widely discussed of this century due to the growing physical and virtual connectivity between countries. However, the study of white-collar crimes and the number of published articles on this subject remain relatively low. To bridge this research gap, we propose an AI-based mechanism that incorporates machine learning, an AI-based chatbot, and GPS technology to categorize white-collar crimes in India and other countries, excluding India. This approach will also enhance collaboration among various governments, authors, students, and educational institutions by establishing a single portal to consolidate information about white-collar crimes.

articleTitle: Simulation Study of a Compact UWB Antenna for Detection of Breast Tumors using Microwave Imaging Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: This research article proposes a miniaturized UWB antenna for breast tumor detection using the radar-based microwave imaging (RBMI) method. The proposed UWB antenna’s top view consists of a stepped tapered microstrip feedline along with a split ring resonator patch structure, whereas the bottom layer of the proposed structure includes a hexagonal concentric ring-like structure in the ground plane to boost the bandwidth. The designed antenna has total volumetric dimensions of 15×12×1.6 mm<sup>3</sup>, operating within the range of frequency from 4.2 GHz to 12 GHz. The proposed antenna is designed and analyzed on Computer Simulation Technology. The simulated backscattered signals are analyzed by keeping the tapered feedline antenna at 20 mm from the target medium. After that, post-processing of the simulated reflection coefficients is carried out to detect the presence of malignant tissue. Moreover, the designed antenna offers the Specific Absorption Rates (SAR) of 1.09 W/Kg over 1g of tissue at 4.8 GHz, which is an acceptable limit for SAR as per FCC guidelines. As a result, the radar-based monostatic microwave imaging, and proposed antenna are suitable for the identification of breast tumors.

articleTitle: Secrecy Outage Probability of NOMA Network under Amplify and Forward Scheme
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: 6G and beyond networks require massive data transfer speeds and exceptionally secure long-distance communication systems. In recent years, Non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) has come up with a highly efficient signal transmission technique. It enables broadcast to numerous users within the same frequency band and time slot, allowing for signal transmission through a single channel. However, the presence of internal or external eavesdroppers poses a big challenge to the physical layer security of a network. This paper analyzes the secrecy performance of the hybrid free space optical-radio frequency (FSO-RF) -aided NOMA network. A novel closed-form expression for secrecy outage probability under amplify and forward scheme (AF) is presented. Additionally, the effects of weak, moderate, and strong turbulence are considered under different decoding techniques. It is noteworthy to mention that the proposed results show perfect agreement with theoretical concepts.

articleTitle: Gain Enhancement in UWB Antenna using AMC Reflector for Wireless Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Here a 3×3 array of dual band AMC metamaterial surface having size of 15 mm ×15 mm is proposed to increase gain value of a UWB antenna with dimension of 30 mm × 30 mm. Every notch created on AMC cell contributes in the generation of two resonance frequencies at 4.7 and 9.9 GHz. The structure of unit cell contains square shaped patch, a ring structure along with a central plus shape slit. AMC feature of having 0-degree reflection phase at two resonance frequencies (4.7 and 9.9 GHz) is also noticed here. Proposed AMC cell is utilized as reflector plain to increase gain and radiation features. Both designs (unit cell and wideband antenna) utilized FR-4 substrate having thickness 1.6 mm and dielectric constant of 4.4. Initially wideband antenna has 5.7 dB of gain and later it was increased to 8.3 dB by using AMC. The effect on metamaterial antenna gain with varying air gap (d) and array size is studied along with the impact on antenna parameters (gain, directivity and radiation pattern) due to grounded or ungrounded AMC structure is also studied to get optimum outcomes. Computer simulation technology (CST) software is used for simulation and simulation outcomes are confirmed with experimental outcomes and they show acceptable agreement.

articleTitle: A Characterization Study of Mutual Coupling between Rectangular Microstrip Patch Antennas
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Mutual coupling is the interaction present between any two or more antennas placed in close proximity. This paper elucidates the findings of a characterization study conducted for the evaluation of mutual coupling between rectangular microstrip antennas (RMSAs) on a common finite ground plane in a configuration which is similar to a military aircraft structure. Initially, we design an RMSA to operate at 1 GHz in a stand-alone configuration. Subsequently, we extend the analysis to calculate the in-band mutual coupling for the case of a pair of identical RMSAs operating at 1 GHz. Analysis using Method of Moments (MoM) has been carried out using the CEM Solver tool Altair FEKO. This analysis is beneficial for identifying optimal antenna location on military aircraft. Concomitantly, Electromagnetic Interference (EMI) between the antenna systems may be limited.

articleTitle: Internet of Things (IoT) Based Cost Effective Weather Monitoring Station
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: The cost-effective weather station proposed here adopts a new practical approach for monitoring the weather conditions at different places and sharing the meteorological data anywhere across the globe. The main feature of the proposed work is the inclusion of Air Quality Index monitoring, it also sends the information to the cloud server. Internet of Things (IoT) is a network of various devices connected together to a system which extracts data from them and utilizes that data for various purposes.

articleTitle: Evaluating the impact of smart city on land use efficiency in Dehradun district by using GIS and Remote Sensing Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: A unique, developing idea known as "smart cities" relies on cutting-edge information and communication systems. Policy makers frequently require precise and updated land use land cover data to effectively represent the city. After forming a new state Uttarakhand from Uttar Pradesh, Dehradun district, the capital of Uttarakhand state, witnessed rapid fluctuations in the land use land cover (LULC) especially with reference to built-up area due to smart city project (urbanization). This research article reveals impact of smart city project on land use efficiency in Dehradun by using remote sensing and GIS techniques. Classification of LANDSAT images are performed by Random Forest (RF) classifier in Google Earth Engine from 2001 to 2022. According to the findings of this investigation, from 2001 to 2022, the built-up area of the Uttarakhand state’s Dehradun district has grown (116%) dramatically, particularly in the city’s core where a smart city project is taking root.

articleTitle: Analysis of AlGaN/GaN Interface Traps in the Enhancement-mode p-GaN HEMT
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Interface trapping is a key factor in deteriorating the performance parameters of GaN high electron mobility transistors (HEMTs). This paper provides a comprehensive study related to AlGaN/GaN interface traps in p-GaN HEMT. The Silvaco ATLAS device simulation tool is used, for analyzing the interface traps, through static I-V and C-V characteristics. For our investigations, the acceptor traps with 0.5eV energy level, are placed at AlGaN/GaN interface in p-GaN HEMT. It is found that the interface traps cause threshold voltage instability and the current collapse in p-GaN HEMT. Finally, the response of interface traps introduces C-V dispersion, particularly in the depletion region of p-GaN HEMT.

articleTitle: IEEE 802.11 DCF MAC Protocol for CR-Enabled WLAN in AdHoc and Infrastructure modes
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Cognitive radio (CR) enabled WLAN is more beneficial in the context of its quality of services and managing spectrum scarcity. Mostly, WLAN is operated with 802.11 (DCF) MAC protocol in AP-based infrastructure mode of its interconnections. But for small distances, WLAN peer-to-peer AdHoc mode of interconnections is more useful, such as conferencing and document file transfer without going through AP. This paper proposes a method for analyzing the throughput and delay performance of the 802.11 (DCF) protocol while taking into account a WLAN that supports CR in both its AdHoc and infrastructure modes. Here, CSMA based 802.11 (DCF) protocol is followed by spectrum sensing (To identify the primary user activity) and evaluate the delay and throughput. The experimental results show that the normalized throughput of the AdHoc mode is approximately 87% higher, and the average delay is approximately 0.7% lower as compared to the infrastructure mode of the proposed CR network scenarios.

articleTitle: Adaptive-Optimal Control for Reconfigurable Robots
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Reconfigurable robots refer to the robotic systems which have the ability to transform their morphological structure to adapt to changes in their surroundings. A specialized control system based upon the dynamic characteristics is required to be modelled so that a vast range of operations can be performed by the reconfigurable robots. Reinforcement learning based technique is therefore considered as a suitable mechanism for carrying out adaptive optimal control for the robotic systems. In this paper, an attempt has been made to model the adaptive optimal control mechanism for a single-link manipulator: a reconfigurable robotic system. The system has been modelled for a dynamic environment. The loss and reward plots are obtained from the simulation of the robotic system by deploying reinforcement learning based techniques with the given controlled input

articleTitle: Classification and Prediction of Kashmiri Apple Plant by using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: "Apple" proudly reflects Kashmir's fruit sector, which accounts for around 88 percent of the valley's overall fruit production. It forms the foundation of the Shopian district's economy in the Kashmir valley. Several factors, including the illness spread across the crops, have sadly prevented a considerable expansion in this industry's production over the past few years. India is an agricultural nation, and it is an important issue for the prompt detection of diseases among plants. Apple growers will be able to take the necessary actions or safeguards to protect the fruits from contamination if apple trees are discovered early. It takes a lot of time and effort to predict apple plant diseases using manual or traditional methods, which also requires providing lab diagnoses. But this is where the new technology comes into play; because of the development of machine learning and deep learning, it is now feasible to rapidly and accurately assess whether a plant is infected or not.

articleTitle: Applying Machine Learning & Knowledge Discovery to Intelligent Agent-Based Recommendation for Online Learning Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: E-learning is one of the favorite jobs where all the learners can learn through different online sites to update their knowledge acquisition. Though online learning supports several benefits, there are many challenges to be considered, for example, the information resources, quality of the search, accessing the correct information, getting the search results within a reasonable computing time, etc. This research develops the new natural language processing (NLP) intelligent and online recommender using the learner's profile information and semantic analysis of the search history at different times. The intelligent clustering strategy is applied, so the system learns automatically, and the learner's characteristics are analyzed periodically. The simulation results of the proposed research are compared with the state-of-the-art techniques and provide the minimized error rates to the selection of courses and recommendations with the recommendation accuracy in (98.2%, 98.9%). The MAE lies between (0.12, 0.35) for the considered clusters. Compared to the other methods, the method works well for clusters of sizes 10, 20, 30, 40, and 50.

articleTitle: Disorientation of Path of Birds Due to Electromagnetic Waves
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: In this manuscript, the disorientation of birds from their paths after the continuous impact of electromagnetic radiation is studied. Birds get the direction of their navigation from a geomagnetic field. In this manuscript, we will study the mechanism, how the resultant geomagnetic field shifts from its position and disorients the birds from its original path. The impact of the electromagnetic field produced by the imposed electromagnetic wave in different directions on the geomagnetic field is drawn and shown in this manuscript. The vector addition method is used to find the resultant of the applied magnetic field and the magnetic field of earth. The diagram shows that the resultant magnetic field is shifted from the original position of the magnetic field of the earth. It becomes the reason for the disorientation of the birds from their original paths.

articleTitle: Analysis of Performance Parameters and Gate Line Spacing Variation of Vertical Organic Light-Emitting Transistors
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Over the last few years, Organic Semiconductor (OSC) materials based electrical (OTFTs, OSITs) and optical (OLEDs) devices have received great attention. It is because of their capability to be used in large-area, low cost and flexible devices. Vertical organic light emitting transistor (VOLET), a blend of OLED and OSIT can be used to obtain fully organic efficient flexible display devices. VOLETs are multifunctional devices as these delivers both electrical and optical functionalities. These exhibit various merits such as lower gate voltage requirement for current and luminescence modulation, high-speed operation and easy fabrication.In this research paper, VOLET performance has been investigated in terms of its electrical as well as optical characteristics through 2-D numerical device simulation by Atlas. In simulated VOLET, α-NPD and Alq<inf>3</inf> has been utilized for hole-transportation and emission, respectively. Besides this, impact of gate line spacing (S<inf>G</inf>) variation is examined by changing it from 0.5 to 1.5µm with a step size of 0.5µm. An increase of 1.24 times in I<inf>on</inf>/ I<inf>off</inf> ratio along with reduction of 2.22 times in threshold voltage is observed with 3 times reduction in S<inf>G</inf>. As a result of reduced S<inf>G</inf>, depletion layer in off state can cover channel region effectively. Thus, current conduction in VOLET can be controlled efficiently with reduced S<inf>G</inf>. However, a large 2.12 times reduction in maximum luminescent power per unit length (P<inf>Lum_max</inf>) is also observed with 3 times reduction in S<inf>G</inf>.

articleTitle: A Hybrid FA for High Performance Arithmetic Application
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: This research introduces a novel hybrid CMOS design model for a 1-bit full adder that addresses the requirements for improved noise-robustness, enhanced drivability, and reduced power consumption in deep submicron technology. The adoption of a hybrid style based on CMOS was explored to fulfil the desired performance of implementing new, fully-featured adders. More freedom to concentrate on different applications allows designers to drastically cut design efforts. There exist various unique designs for the full adder (FA), but this research proposes a new FA design implemented using CMOS technology with 90nm. The design employs an XOR-XNOR circuit that produces exclusive OR/exclusive NOR full-swing outputs and is utilized to construct FA is presented first. The proposed work offers improvement in latency and power delay products by 6.27 to 38.24 and 13.27 percent, respectively, over the prior design.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Analysis of the Architecture of Static Random Access Memory Utilizing CMOS for Mobile Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: The modern electronic industry is always searching for ways to improve its power efficiency and processing speed. Because of this, SRAM is included in every IC to increase its functionality. The utilization of high-tech devices that rely on memory like RAM is the outcome of the technology's rapid advancement for matter and speedier invention to smooth out human necessities like mobile. The size and power consumption to fulfill the growing demand is the goal. To optimize latency and power, this research study focuses on a comprehensive investigation of SRAM (static random access memory). In this study, the performance of read and write operations for SRAM cells supporting a 6T, 9T, and 10T configuration is compared. In this study, a new SRAM is developed to meet the needs of low-power, high-performance circuits. Major chip space is used by the SRAM block, which causes leakage of power in more contemporary systems. Scaling the voltage supply of SRAM macros is an effective way to lower chip power overall. Conventional 6T SRAMs cannot meet the demands for density and yield in the sub-threshold area. Reducing the power and area of SRAM is the aim of this work. We compare the new (4T) SRAM and 32 nm CMOS technique with the conventional six-transistor (6T) RAM cell. Here, many SRAM cell configurations for one-bit, sixteen-bit, sixty-four-bit, and one Kb may be developed and tested, employing both a unique load-less 4T SRAM unit & 6T SRAM unit using 32nm CMOS technology. The novel load-less 4T SRAM array takes less energy so it occupies a smaller region than a 6T array.

articleTitle: Impact of Parasitic Resistance on Modelling and Performance of Solar Photovoltaic Module
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: A solar cell is a transducer, converting light energy into DC power. Among all renewable energy, solar photovoltaic energy is a clean and green energy. Due to low cost and high efficiency power generation, it is most popular emerging technology towards energy transformation. Therefore modeling of SPV system is required to analyze the performance of SPV system. An increase in internal resistance either series or parallel of the photovoltaic (PV) cell effect the characteristics and the performance of the system. In this research, we have done the modeling of polycrystalline PV module on MATLAB. Modeling is done on 150 kW SPV systems. The field test is also done on same parameters in the city of Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India. Data collected from the MATLAB test shows the degradation in the conversion efficiency of power generation and affecting the system performance.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation and Analysis of IoT Network using KNN and SVM
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Everything in today’s world has related to the Internet of Things (IoT) with help of sensors. Due to digitization of the machines and household products Internet of Things (IoT) has become a name worldwide today and became a necessity for every second person. IoT is effectively implemented in air conditioners, refrigerators, bulb wristwatches, washing machines, mobile phones, and almost all automated home appliances, etc. It has had a significant social impact on everyone's lives, but as the number of IoT networks grows the number of cyber-attacks also grows. Now it became imperative to secure our IoT Networks or to reduce them from cyberattacks in the form of Botnet Malware or any other malware through Machine Learning (ML) concepts or techniques. Machine Learning has played a major role in the detection of IoT botnet attacks. Most technology, including Machine Learning and Deep Learning, has been incorporated in some form or another from Artificial Intelligence (AI), Cloud Computing, and even IoT in terms of IoT network security and how we will assess and enhance network performance. This paper seeks to address the concern of security attacks on IoT Networks and use Machine Learning methods/models, specifically the K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) algorithm and Support Vector Machine (SVM) to improve the performance of the network of IoT devices.

articleTitle: Design and Investigation of graphene based 2 × 2 CPW feed Vivaldi MIMO Antenna for THz Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: In this paper, 2 × 2 CPW feed Vivaldi multiple-input-multiple-outputs (MIMO) antenna is projected for different Terahertz (THz) applications. Graphene material is utilized over the radiating copper patch of Vivaldi’s arm to enhance the conductivity and achieve the frequency reconfigurability of the proposed design. The projected antenna is configured by placing all four elements at the orthogonal position to each other. Also, all the elements are structured on the SiO2 substrate having a dielectric permittivity of 3.75. Reconfigurable characteristics are observed by changing the chemical potential with bias voltage of graphene sheets. This Vivaldi-structured MIMO antenna shows good isolation (>25 dB), maximum Gain of 10 dB, and maximum radiation efficiency of around 92.5% in the operating frequency band from 0.65 THz to 1.3 THz. The Envelop-Correlation-Coefficient (ECC) and Diversity-Gain (DG) are also studied to verify the MIMO performance.

articleTitle: Development of Lane and Zebra Crossing Marker Detection Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: This research involves using an object recognition system and an ancillary image sensor to detect lane markers and zebra crossings on a roadway in a vehicle. To perform this detection, these steps have been followed: take a picture of the scene, digitize it, normalize it, define a search area within it, look for lane and zebra markers within it. The Lane Tracking for Driving System was created to assist drivers in making lane departure decisions, to lessen concentration breaks, and to avoid accidents while driving. To offer a way to detect a specific traffic violation—namely, stopping on a zebra crossing at a traffic signal rather than following behind it—and to offer a workaround. In the proposed work, systems are implemented and improved using adaptive algorithms. MATLAB’s image processing toolbox is used to design and implement the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Design and Investigation of Stacked Nanosheet Transistor Parameters for Analog Performance
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: The work proposes a characteristic analysis of nanosheet MOSFET and also analyzed on the basis of analog application performance. A substack design for better AF performance is proposed after studying the effects of stack number and spacing on the performance of the device. Analog performance can be improved with a novel substack design, and substack spacing should be kept to a minimum. FETs display lower power consumption and low short channel effects when the gate length is extremely scaled and stacked. As a result, the proposed stacked nanosheet FET proves to be a strong contender for high frequency and low power applications at the nano-regime. The reported results show that proposed stacked nanosheet has better analog performance.

articleTitle: Four Legged Parallel Manipulator for Autonomous Delivery Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: The COVID-19 outbreak has been designated a pandemic and is spreading quickly around the world. The industries most impacted by COVID-19, which has proved a barrier to every major business, were the e-commerce businesses that use door-to-door delivery methods. It's critical to have an unmanned strategy that can be applied to diverse sites during this key time. Although the driverless vehicle is not a novel idea, problems can occur when these systems run into the uneven pavement or unexpected obstacles. The methods for ensuring the stability of the commodities delivered by autonomous robots are discussed in this research. This mechanism guards against product damage. Additionally, a motor that stabilizes a robot's product compartment uses a gyroscope sensor to detect angular rotation and axial movement and preserve the orientation of a quadrupedal leg. In order to conduct trials that mimic problems in the real world, rectify errors, and offer solutions, a prototype model of a robot's stability platform has been created. This type of technological advancement will aid us in future efforts to combat global catastrophes.

articleTitle: Design of Frequency Domain Metric for Evaluation of Mode Decomposition Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Mode decomposition algorithms have been used extensively to extract and separate signal components from composite signals which constitute the semantic information in it. The individual signal components also called modes should be independent of each other and have some sparsity properties such as having a limited bandwidth and should be compact around a center frequency. However, not all algorithms effectively segregate the constituents truthfully. Different algorithms perform differently for the same input signal. This work proposes a metric to quantify the performance of mode decomposition techniques by leveraging the analogy of having a compact central frequency in the decomposed modes. The proposed method is tested on the widely used mode decomposition algorithms. The results on simulated and real signals show the usefulness of the proposed metric in evaluating mode decomposition algorithms.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Crop Recommendation Systems Employing Diverse Machine Learning Methodologies
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: For the purpose of assisting farmers in making knowledgeable choices on crop management, this research suggests a crop recommendation system based on machine learning algorithms. To assess soil data and suggest the optimal crop management practices to farmers, the system makes use of Decision Tree, Naive Bayes, KNN, Random Forest, and XG-Boost. The research discovered that agricultural yields may be reliably predicted using machine learning algorithms, and these algorithms can also recommend the best crop management techniques, resulting in higher crop output at a reduced cost. The suggested method presents a possible answer to the problems the agriculture sector faces, such as population growth and changing dietary tastes.

articleTitle: ASD Diagnosis in Children, Adults, and Adolescents using Various Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: ASD, often known as an autism spectrum disorder, is a neurodevelopmental condition that impairs a person’s capacity for successful social interaction and communication. The long-term results for individuals affected can be significantly improved by early detection and proper diagnosis of this disorder. Traditional diagnostic techniques, however, might take a while and are not always accurate. In order to solve these challenges, this study investigates the use of machine learning to diagnose ASD. The research uses a big dataset of behavioral and demographic data from individuals with and without autism to train and evaluate machine learning algorithms. The findings imply that these algorithms can identify autism with more accuracy than current techniques. This implies that machine learning may be a useful technique for making an early and precise diagnosis of ASD

articleTitle: The Future IoT: The Current Generation 5G and Next Generation 6G and 7G Technologies
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Internet of things can be referred to as embedded objects, and broad band cellular networking technologies 5G/6G/7G for connecting people and transferring data over the Internet. The Internet of Things (IoT) combines many different objects and communication strategies. The term "Internet of Things" (IoT) refers to the concept of everything connected to the internet. Because it allows for new services and developments, IoT will be critical in the future. There are numerous applications of Internet of Things varying from simple home automation to complex ones like smart cities, smart farming and smart transportation etc. All objects/devices under IoT are connected to a network. In near future, the emerging technology like Internet of Things have a prediction to dominate traditional concept of controlling devices, IoT bring about huge amount of traffic as a result of the strong interaction among the millions of connected things available at the time of deployment to particular application. The increase in the popularity of the Internet of Things has been likened to an increase in the number of barriers. In this study, the current use of 5G edge network infrastructure with IoT enabled, and hybrid and multi-cloud deployments need 6G and 7G technologies, and we examine the current state of IoT, as well as potential conditions and challenges that may influence IoT acquisition. In this paper there is a comparison of different communication technology in the context of IoT. At the end of the paper the impact of 5G, 6G, and beyond 7G technologies have been discussed in the preface of IoT.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Techniques for Node Localization in WSN: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) encompasses various tiny sensor nodes. The prime objective of these nodes is the monitoring of the environment. These nodes collect and forward the data for efficient information transmission. During the data transmission, it becomes crucial to localize the nodes. Apart from this, these networks are highly dynamic, and traditional localization techniques are not sufficient to deal with the issues generated by rapidly moving sensor nodes. Hence, machine learning (ML) techniques take place which can tackle such issues conveniently and efficiently. This survey provides a thorough study of various ML techniques used for localization in WSN along with localization techniques. A detailed literature survey has also been produced to show the advantages of using ML techniques for localization.

articleTitle: Field Effect Transistor (FET)-Sensor for Biological Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: The necessity of FET-Biosensors in many fields has prompted the development of considerably more easily than traditional tests. As signal-to-noise ratio, sensing surface properties, and other accurate and potent biosensors, since they can gather information more quickly and quantitative and qualitative performance parameters will eventually be taken into account, this paper will primarily focus on these parameters to discuss the current challenges in device design. By doing so, it will be possible to address some of the most pressing issues with device design and practical restrictions. Moreover, this article included systematic development of performance parameters along with their outstanding electrical characteristics, compactness, scalability and applications.

articleTitle: Synthetic Image Generation for Visual Particle Size Distribution Estimation based on U-NET Convolutional Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Many applications in the field of bulk material handling require the determination of the Particle Size Distribution (PSD) of the handled materials. Typically, this can only be achieved by manual sampling and a subsequent laboratory analysis. However, the availability of novel image segmentation algorithms based on Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) leads to the possibility for an implementation of visual PSD estimation techniques. One prominent example of such approaches is the U-Net image segmentation architecture. However, one fundamental problem for the training of the underlying CNN is the difficulty to gather ground truth data, since the exact correspondence between a set of images and the underlying particle sizes cannot be achieved in practice. This paper introduces a novel synthetic image generation procedure for the visual PSD estimation by using the U-NET structure. The overall approach is validated and verified by using a prototypic implementation of a U-NET segmentation pipeline. It is shown, that the proposed synthetic image dataset generation can be applied for all visual PSD estimation based on machine learning algorithms.

articleTitle: Fusion of Artificial Intelligence and 5G in Defining Future UAV Technologies - A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: In the modern world, drones or unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) are utilized for many different things and have lately attracted much scientific attention to the changing geo-political state. In addition to the military and businesses, scientists and researchers have used drones to study space and the ocean and find endangered species. Improved remote control and better communications are essential for any drone operation, which got a boost with innovation in 5G networks. A successful and fully operational modern 5G wireless network requires artificial intelligence (AI) procedures. Current 4G networks' reactive architecture with all-IP (Internet Protocol) internet access leads to inferior spectrum efficiency. Due to developments in AI and related subfields, such as machine learning and deep learning, fifth-generation (5G) wireless networks may now be proactive and predictive. The improved AI and sensor technology features are critical to achieving the 5G target and innovation with UAV techs. The study examines the possibilities of AI-based solutions in relation to UAV and 5G smart devices. The goal is to evaluate the various obstacles and unresolved problems facing UAV advancements and how the UAV revolution is changing the globe.

articleTitle: Leveraging the Power of ‘Modeling and Computer Simulation’ for Education: An Exploration of its Potential for Improved Learning Outcomes and Enhanced Student Engagement
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Modeling and computer simulation has emerged as an important tool in education as it provides a platform for students to engage in hands-on learning experiences that are interactive, immersive, and personalized. In this paper, the researcher explores the applications of modeling and simulation in education as a means of improving learning outcomes and student engagement. This scientific investigation examines the benefits of employing modeling and computer simulation in teaching complex scientific and engineering concepts, developing virtual labs for hands-on learning, personalizing learning experiences, supporting teacher professional development, and assessing student learning and progress. Furthermore, the researcher demonstrates the use of the programming language Python to simulate the behavior of computer algorithms and provide real-world context for learning. The findings of the study suggest that the use of modeling and computer simulation has the potential to significantly enhance student learning outcomes and engagement, as well as to provide a dynamic and interactive learning environment that supports personalization and creativity.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Theoretical and Experimental Analysis of DDoS Attacks in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Researchers frequently turn to cloud computing due to its services, applications, and advantages. It boosts the accessibility of resources over the internet, which leads to risk because data is transmitted over an unsecured network. Various cyber- attacks affect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability (CIA) of systems connected via the internet. The massive threat posed by Distributed Denial of Service (DDOS) keeps rising quickly. Due to their ability to pass as legitimate traffic, most DDoS attacks remain undetectable. Implementing intrusion detection systems (IDS) can help to partially resolve these challenges. Hence, the authors have focused on DDoS attacks in this paper and implemented the state of art Machine learning (ML) approaches to analyze the performance. The article will serve as a stepping stone for new researchers in the area of cloud security.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Nature-Inspired Optimization Algorithms for Chronic Disease Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Chronic Diseases have spread speedily over the last one and a half decades; these life-threatening chronic diseases have a significantly higher rate of morbidity and fatality. Illness diagnosis using machine learning methods helps to decrease the percentage of fatality. On the other hand, Optimization algorithms address a broad range of problems while being flexible and adaptive. Such nature-inspired optimization algorithms are Genetic Algorithms (GA), Ant Colony Optimization (ACO), Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Artificial Bee Colonies (ABC), and many more. These methods have been employed in the early prediction of many illnesses. This article investigates the effectiveness of several nature-inspired optimization strategies in diagnosing chronic illness. Compared to ACO, GA, and ABC algorithms, PSO has been widely used in an illness diagnosis. Furthermore, combining optimization approaches yields better results than using them separately.

articleTitle: Dynamics of business and opportunities for employability using predictive modeling tools of Machine Learning and R programming
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Employability is a major concern in India along with poverty, economy, education, pollution, and population growth. To combat the concern, each higher education institution in India is striving hard to comply with the nuances of the market. To enhance the employability of job seekers, it is essential to address certain factors that contribute to their increased employability. This study has identified twelve such variables from the extant literature. Thereafter, the data has been collected from Institutions preferably imparting professional education on the twelve identified variables and the dependent variable, employability. Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest, and Naïve Bayes as classification techniques of data mining have been adopted in this study to predict the employability of job seekers. These classification techniques were used and the highest accuracy of 0.97 with Area under ROC was 0.99 received using Random Forest. The accuracy levels and AUC of all the classification techniques are very high, it means these twelve variables have substantial role in classification of the dependent variable, employability. The top seven variables Domain Knowledge, Problem Solving, Computer Skills, General Awareness, Teamwork, Analytical Thinking and Creativity play important roles in classification of employability. Therefore, the management institutes should focus on these variables to enhance the employability of the students. The future scope of this study can be used for other professional programs like MCA, Engineering, Diploma etc.

Index Terms: Area Under Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Various Breath Assist Devices and the Effect of Sleep Apnea (SA) Among the Indian Population
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Sleep-related disorders (SRDs) and their implications are frequent but they are often under-reported and mostly ignored. Sleep apnoea is one of the most common SRD, commonly neglected or unnoticed due to a lack of proper insights into its ill effects. Obstructive sleep apnoea (OSA) causes the ceasing of breath several times within an hour during sleep. This paper aims to discuss the need to screen and treat OSA among Indian populations. Also, discuss various CPAP instruments available and the latest methodologies used to automate the air pressure from the blower/air pump. This can facilitate researchers in this field to accustom the device to the emerging need of the Indian population and opt for suitable sensors, algorithms, or methodology based on the patient sleep parameters. A device most suitable for the Indian population is needed to cater for the needs of OSA patients in India. An online survey, from 79 responses, 74.3% were filled by women and 25.6% were from Men, among which 29.4% fall under the age group of 20-30 years, 42.3% fall under 30-40 years age group, 23% belong to 40-50 age group and 0.05% belong to above 50 age group and 23% of the totally set fall under obese category as their BMI is above 30. It was found that 61.5% are totally unaware of OSA. The Epworth Sleepiness Scale (ESS) score was calculated, it is noted that the individuals with excessive day time sleepiness are mostly aged above 40 despite their BMI being within 30. There is greater possibility for them to have OSA which is greatly ignored given the fact their vitals are stable at the moment. From the Berlin Questionnaire for sleep evaluation, It is noted that 17.94% of the individuals who filled the questionnaire have a high likelihood of sleep disordered breathing whose profession include teaching and IT sector.

articleTitle: Strengthening Data Security of India using a mixed approach of Cryptography and Steganography Techniques: A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: There has been steady growth in many internet applications for digital communication. Therefore, there is a need to provide secure communication on the network, in particular for intelligence agencies and armed forces. Consequently, transmitting data security over a network is essential to network performance. Both Cryptography and Steganography are used individually to ensure data security by encrypting and hiding the data. Still, a single approach is not enough to protect the data, especially confidential one, from unauthorized access. Therefore, a combined approach of Cryptography and Steganography can be utilized to ensure a high level of data security. This paper includes a theoretical review of different combination techniques already in use with their limitations to achieve a hybrid system for enhancing data security. Moreover, this paper outlines some differences between steganography and cryptography.

articleTitle: FPGA Implementation of Chaotic Oscillators
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: In this work, FPGA implementation of Chaotic Oscillators based on Lü-Chen, Lorenz, Chen, Pehlivan-Wei and Rössler Chaotic Systems has been carried out using two different numerical methods, namely, Euler’s Numerical Method and Heun’s Numerical Method. This work consists of a concise description of the algorithms of these Chaotic Systems, which is followed by a brief explanation of the two numerical methods. A detailed account about the FPGA implementation of the Chaotic Oscillators is also presented. The 32-bit Signed Fixed Point Number Format has been employed for the representation of all the system parameters and values of inputs and outputs. In addition to Chaotic Oscillators, Pseudo Random Number Generators (PRNGs) based on each of the Chaotic Oscillators are also implemented, that produces an output at each clock cycle along with the Chaotic Oscillator. The algorithm of this implemented PRNG has also been explained. The designed system has been simulated and synthesized targeting the Xilinx Artix-7 family of FPGA. Subsequently, Chaotic Oscillators have been compared in terms of Resource Utilisation, Power and Speed. This work elucidates the details of the simulation and testing process of the PRNGs based on the Chaotic Oscillators. The Frequency (Monobit) Test, which is the first test of NIST Statistical Test Suite, has been performed on the pseudorandom bit sequences generated by the PRNGs using MATLAB. Lastly, the results of the testing of PRNGs have been explained along with the conclusion and scope of future work.

articleTitle: A Systematic Literature Review: Approach Toward Blockchain Future Research Trends
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: A decentralised peer-to-peer technology called blockchain offers security services based on the following four core ideas: authentication, confidentiality, integrity, and authorisation. The purpose of this paper is to provide an overview of the blockchain’s mechanism, architecture, and various components. It also compares different blockchain types based on various parameters and their applicability. This paper also emphasises the general security of blockchain. We evaluate the blockchain in particular to create thorough categories for blockchain security risks, examine actual attacks by bugs against the blockchain, and list recently created security measures for the technology. This paper also demonstrates the significance of various blockchain applications in the fields of healthcare, IoT, smart grid, governance, defence, and military. Overall, this paper provides an overview of various blockchain applications, their characteristics, challenges, and potential future.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Thyroid Model for Prediction System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Deep learning and cytopathology identification have trended in recent decades. Whole slide images (WSI) from clinic e-scanners help researchers classify slides (benign or malignant). In a thyroid WSI, the crucial area that supports the detection result may be smaller, and only the worldwide label may be gathered, making the supervised learning framework impracticable. Clinical thyroid cell identification requires many visual cues across several scales, therefore standard feature extraction may not work. This study proposes a poorly guided multi-instance-based learning technique for cytopathological thyroid diagnosis using Multi-Scale Feature Fusion (MSF) and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). WSIs are pouches with numerous occurrences for each section. Architecture learns to automatically categorise important sections. A feature fusion architecture that merges minimum features in the feature map with an instance-level awareness model improves classification results. The suggested model, trained and verified on clinical data, outperforms all existing methods with 93.2% accuracy. Our model outperformed ultra-modern deep multi-instance technique on a publically accessible histopathology dataset.

articleTitle: An Improved Video Recommendation System for IoT Devices Using Federated Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Video recommendation progressively adds new dimensions to the application of Internet of Things (IoT). JointRec, a video recommendation architecture for minority users, introduced federated learning in the JointCloud operation. In our work, the proposed design trains the edge end devices of the local clouds incorporating Federated Swapping (FedSwap) into Federated Averaging (FedAvg) operation during cloud weight aggregation. The implemented Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model uses Dual Convolutional Probabilistic Matrix Factorization (Dual-CPMF) method in the parallel training of clouds. The communication cost of weighted file transmission is handled with a compression aggregator. After 10 training rounds, this model obtains RMSE = 0.8558 and aggregates 1.43 Gbits validating the prediction accuracy and communication efficiency of the proposed video recommendation system.

articleTitle: Metaheuristic Algorithm Implementation for PV Array Reconfiguration under Realistic Moving Cloud Condition
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Partial shading imposes a major issue while generating power using solar photovoltaics (SPV) and consequences in the formation of hot spots and manifold peaks in the power-voltage (P-V) curve of the SPV arrays. As a result, a main deforming concern arises i.e., The power loss due to mismatch in the SPV system is dependent on and directly caused by the shading pattern. Mitigation of this MPL can be assessed by selecting a proper configuration of the SPV array and optimal shading dispersion over the complete SPV array. This paper focuses on the implementation of renowned metaheuristic algorithms (MAs) to optimally disperse the shading effect for a partially shaded total-cross-tied (TCT) SPV array configuration. A partial shading effect is generated using a realistic moving cloud model by incorporating various affecting environmental parameters. Furthermore, MAs are tested for the designed moving cloud model and a comprehensive analysis is presented among the various SPV array configurations.

articleTitle: Low-Cost Blind-Aid Stick to Prevent Accidents of Visually Impaired People
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Making life easier has long been a goal of technological development. Everyone today, with the exception of some segments of society, is utilizing the advantages of technology due to a fast-paced lifestyle. The visually impaired are one of them, as they must depend on others for transportation and other activities. This paper intends to present one such theoretical framework that uses cutting-edge technology to offer effective and clever electronic assistance to the blind. This study describes an Arduino-powered walking stick for the blind. This tool makes it easier and more comfortable for blind persons to work and notice impediments. For people who are visually challenged, a conventional stick does not effectively identify obstacles. The device uses an ultrasonic sensor to measure the separation between objects and the Blind-Aid Stick. The ultrasonic sensor can be informed of obstacles by hearing the buzzer's sound when they are within hearing distance of the sensor. By alerting the user to any obstructions in his path, it enables unfettered walking. With the aid of the respective sensors' produced infrared and ultrasonic waves, this proposed methodology is employed to identify the obstruction. A shock sensor is employed to detect whether a physical shock or collision has taken place. An alarm SMS with the location is automatically sent to the ambulance unit using GSM and GPS when it is presumed from the impact that an accident has happened. The major goal of this technology is to create a smart Blind-Aid stick that is extremely helpful for visually impaired folks who frequently require assistance from others.

articleTitle: Comparative study of Structures of Electrochromic Device for Flexible Electrochromic Display
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Electrochromic devices are gaining popularity in both academic and industrial domains. In recent years, these devices have received a lot of attention because of their ability to change their optical properties when a voltage is applied across their terminals. There is currently a lot of research being carried out in this domain to enhance the flexibility of these devices. This article highlights the various structures of electrochromic devices. The article provides an overview of electrochromic materials as well as a comparison of the traditional seven-layer structure with five-layer, four-layer, and three-layer structures. The procedure of switching metal oxide to conductive polymers as an electrochromic material such as PEDOT: PSS, Polyalanine is also discussed in this review.

articleTitle: Standalone SEIG using Smart Meta-Heuristic Algorithm to Optimize its Performance and Loadability
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Induction generator used in offshore areas for wind conversion has the disadvantage of poor terminal voltage. This is owing to the unpredictability of wind speed. Therefore, this paper primarily emphasis on performance of induction generator under self-excitation. In an effort to improve its terminal voltage, the optimal values of capacitance have been chosen in this paper for different configurations. In doing so, three meta-heuristic algorithms named as Plant Propagation Algorithm based on strawberry plant colonization, Genetic Algorithm based on natural selection and Gravitational Search Algorithm based on Law of gravity have been used and compared. For the optimized outputs, significant constraints such as equality, inequality, and bounded limitations are taken into account. This study focused on both resistive and inductive types of loads. The findings of the simulation results shows that the plant propagation algorithm regulates voltage and frequency better than the gravitational search algorithm and genetic algorithm in self-excited induction generator machines.

articleTitle: IoT Enabled Low-Cost Real-Time Remote Air Quality Monitoring and Forecasting System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Gas poisoning and other health problems can be greatly avoided using forecasting and prediction of air quality. These metrics were previously observed using huge, pricey, and fixed air quality monitoring stations. Due to their high cost, these stations cannot be installed in many locations, which results in a dearth of monitoring stations in many locations. These problems can be solved with the use of compact, affordable, and portable air quality monitoring systems. Additionally, it is possible to automate and monitor air quality using inexpensive air quality monitoring equipment. These systems can be used in any home and office, car and etc. In this paper, we built and put into action a portable, affordable, and tiny hardware platform for monitoring air quality that can be accessed remotely through a web application. Additionally, we have used a dataset and certain forecasting algorithms to predict each parameter over a given time frame.

articleTitle: Localization in Precision Agriculture: A Machine Learning Perspective
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: Due to population expansion, frequent climate change, and resource constraints, it is now challenging to supply the food needs of the current population. A cutting-edge method to address current difficulties with agricultural sustainability is known as precision agriculture. For effectively managing agricultural land it is a must to monitor it. By deploying the nodes, this task becomes easy. To facilitate effective information transmission, these nodes gather and transmit the data. Localizing the nodes becomes essential during data transfer. Aside from that, these networks are quite dynamic, and conventional localization methods are inadequate to address the problems brought on by quickly moving sensor nodes. As a result, machine learning (ML) approaches are used to solve these problems quickly and effectively. This paper provides a detailed discussion of precision agriculture (PA), the need for localization and ML algorithms in PA, and their limitations.

articleTitle: DDoS Attacks Analysis with Cyber Data Forensics using Weighted Logistic Regression and Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: The internet has become an additional domain of warfare, alongside land, air, space, and sea, as technology has advanced. Cyberattacks can have a significant impact on both individual and national security, making the security of cyberspace a key concern for researchers. One prominent type of attack is the Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attack. DDoS attacks flood a targeted network or service with a high volume of traffic from multiple compromised systems, causing a denial of service for legitimate users. These attacks are a significant threat to cloud-based services. This paper presents a cyber forensics approach to analyze and classify these attacks by collecting benchmark network traffic datasets which fall under the Bigdata category. This is because DDoS attacks can generate a large amount of traffic in a short period of time. An exploratory data analysis approach in the Machine Learning Phase is proposed. Dask, an extensible parallel computing framework built on Python with machine learning, is used to uncover insights and understand patterns that may not be immediately obvious from the table. The proposed approach is evaluated using benchmark DDoS data and demonstrates its effectiveness in identifying attack characteristics and providing insight for defense. The results show the usefulness of cyber forensics in improving cloud security.

articleTitle: Comprehensive approach of real time web-based face recognition system using Haar Cascade and LBPH algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Device Intelligence, Computing and Communication Technologies, (DICCT)
abstract: The goal of our research is to propose a system that automatically marks the attendance among the students in class using a webcam with Face Recognition. Since traditional ways of taking attendance are not that useful as it is highly time-consuming to mark the attendance of every student by calling their names as well as the use of papers to mark the attendance also affects our environment, therefore our system helps to save time as well as its eco-friendly as no paper is needed, helps to solve problems of fake attendance and proxies. The Haar Cascade & LBPH algorithms are used in this work to develop a Student’s Attendance System with facial recognition technology. Face detection and recognition are two steps in realtime human face recognition. As of Haar Cascades algorithm’s excellent precision and high real-time permit rate, which is implemented in OpenCV via the Python language, we use it for face detection. The training phase and evaluation phase are two categories taken into consideration in face recognition. The algorithm is trained during the training phase using samples of the image to be learned and the test image is compared across all trained samples in the dataset during the estimate step. By using Local Binary Patterns Histogram(LBPH), the live stream’s faces are recognized & the face characteristics are taken out. Face recognition is completed using the Euclidean distance classifier using the LBPH. The control of the system in computer-based communication is significantly impacted by authentication. The system will automatically keep track of students' attendance in a classroom and will give faculty members the ability to conveniently access student data by keeping a log of their clock-in times.
